jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: **About Arena Intelligence** ============================ Arena is the platform for evaluating how AI models perform in the real world. Founded by researchers from UC Berkeley's SkyLab, we're on a mission to measure and advance the frontier of AI for real\-world use, and to build the foundation for everyone to understand, shape, and benefit from it. Tens of millions of people use Arena each month to evaluate how frontier systems handle the work they actually do. The preferences they share power the most transparent, rigorous, and human\-centered evaluations in AI. Leading AI labs, enterprises, and independent researchers rely on our work and open datasets to understand how models behave in real workflows: agentic coding, creative generation, professional productivity, and beyond. We go beyond leaderboards and decompose what human experience reveals about AI, so models advance toward the work people actually do. We're a team of researchers, academics, builders, and creatives from UC Berkeley, Google, Stanford, and DeepMind. We seek truth, move fast, and value craftsmanship, curiosity, and impact over hierarchy. We're building a company where thoughtful, curious people from all backgrounds can do their best work together, in an office culture that radiates excellence, energy, and focus. ### **About the Role** This role has two core parts, both centered around working closely with the best AI labs in the world. First, you’ll partner directly with our lab customers to integrate their models, run and deliver evals, and act as their go\-to person at Arena Intelligence. You’ll plug into their research roadmap, understand where they’re headed, and help them get real value from our data. Along the way, you’ll spot gaps, surface new opportunities, and help shape what we build next. Second, you’ll roll up your sleeves and build. You’ll take on specific customer engineering asks and ship solutions that push the frontier of what our platform can do. Some of what you build may eventually scale into our Data or Applied ML stack — but it starts with solving real, high\-impact problems for cutting\-edge AI teams. ### **You’ll** * Own 5–15 active model lab relationships as the day\-to\-day point of contact * Partner directly with researchers and product teams to integrate models, run evals, and deliver high\-quality results * Drive consistent delivery across onboarding, data \+ product releases, co\-launches, and unblock unexpected issues fast * Be the “owner” of a key process improvement or automation (e.g., model onboarding flow, customer data insights, delivery tooling) * Translate customer feedback and research direction into concrete product ideas and engineering work * Work across the stack to ship pragmatic solutions that push the frontier for our customers * Help expand strategic accounts through trust, execution, and sharp technical judgment ### **You’ll have** * 4\+ years of software engineering experience with strong fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, system design) * Production experience in **TypeScript** and modern web frameworks * Hands\-on experience integrating LLM provider APIs, including streaming responses * Comfort moving across frontend and backend — you’re willing to dig in wherever the problem is * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and CI/CD workflows * Strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to operate in ambiguity * Clear, concise communication skills — you can explain complex technical ideas to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders * A customer\-first mindset and a genuine desire to work closely with multiple stakeholders **What we offer** ================= * We offer competitive compensation and equity aligned to the markets where our team members are based. The base salary range will depend on the candidate’s permanent work location. * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and additional support programs. * The opportunity to work on cutting\-edge AI with a small, mission\-driven team * A culture that values transparency, trust, and community impact Come help build the space where anyone can explore and help shape the future of AI. Arena Intelligence *provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.* Compensation Range: $150K \- $250K

jobs.title: Controls & Embedded Systems Engineer - Prototype Development
jobs.description: **About American Turbines** The power grid was built for a world that no longer exists. Centralized generation, hundred\-mile transmission lines, decade\-long permitting cycles. Meanwhile, demand is exploding: AI data centers, industrial electrification, remote operations that need megawatts yesterday and can't wait for utilities to catch up. American Turbines is designing small modular gas turbines, purpose\-built for distributed power generation. Machines designed from a blank sheet to be manufactured at scale, clustered in arrays. Hundreds of units operating in parallel, dynamically matching load like a compute cluster matches demand. We are a seed\-stage company backed by the investors behind SpaceX, Boom Supersonic, and Hadrian. **About the Role** The Controls \& Embedded Systems Engineer will own getting American Turbines' first turbine to actually run: the embedded controls and firmware that take it from start to steady\-state operation, keep it running through every test, and shut it down safely when something goes wrong. This includes owning the P\&ID, sensor selection, and valve and plumbing choices, since those decisions are inseparable from what you're controlling, but the job is making the engine work. You will work directly with the test team to get the right sensors on the rig and define the control logic and firmware the engine actually runs on. As testing reveals what the engine needs versus what we assumed, you're the one closing that loop. This is not a role where controls comes in after the hardware is built. You will be embedded in the build from early on, shaping component choices around what's controllable and observable. **What We're Looking For** Experience with embedded controls and firmware for rotating machinery, engines, or similarly real\-time, safety\-critical systems. You've taken a system from a blank sheet to actually running, not just simulated or spec'd out. You think in failure modes and control loops as much as you think in code. You know how much of this job is judgment calls under uncertainty rather than clean spec work, and you'd rather be watching the engine run than writing the document that describes it. **Compensation** $175,000 to $225,000 base. Generous stock package. Medical, vision, and dental care. 2% matching on 401(k).

jobs.title: Expert Senior Software Engineer — AI Code Review
jobs.description: Expert Senior Software Engineer — AI Code Review is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. You will build evaluations, data and inference workflows, backend services, internal tools, and product\-facing experiments while working directly with the founders and researchers. Your job is to shorten the path from hypothesis to reliable software and bring failures observed in real products and real data back into the next experiment. As the technology develops, you will help turn model outputs into useful forecasting, scenario\-exploration, and decision\-support capabilities. This is not a narrow ML infrastructure role, a pure research role, or a management job. You will own reusable technical capabilities, partnering with the data engineer on shared data foundations and the product engineer on the applications that expose those capabilities to users. **What you'll own** * Turn research and agent ideas into working prototypes, evaluations, internal tools, and customer\-ready capabilities. * Build reusable systems for forecasting, covariate search, model\-input preparation, inference, evaluation, and decision support. * Work across model code, APIs, data contracts, workflows, backend services, and lightweight product experiments. * Investigate failures in models, agents, and their surrounding systems, and turn findings into better evaluations and more dependable behavior. * Improve developer experience, observability, reliability, security, and deployment speed where they unlock more research and product progress. * Work with the CTO, Chief Scientist, and CEO on technical direction and the capabilities needed for customer deployments. * Help set the engineering standards for the team, including testing, technical documentation, and sound decisions about what to build or reuse. **What we're looking for** * A track record of taking ambiguous technical problems from an initial idea through implementation and reliable production use. * Strong software engineering skills across backend services, APIs, data workflows, testing, and debugging. * Hands\-on experience taking ML models or agent\-based systems into production, including evaluation, integration, failure analysis, and ongoing operation. * The ability to work in research and model code while also building maintainable services and developer tooling. * Technical judgment about when to experiment, when to invest in reusable infrastructure, and when a simpler solution is sufficient. * Clear communication and the ability to collaborate directly with researchers, product engineers, and founders. **First 90 days** * 30 days: Understand the modeling stack, data infrastructure, and how our technology is used in Ask The Grid; identify one high\-impact system to own. * 60 days: Ship a working capability that converts research, data, or customer learning jobs.title: Founding GTM
jobs.description: **About Proof of Human** ------------------------ Proof of Human is building the global standard for human verification across the internet. As the line between human and machine behavior becomes harder to discern, establishing who or what is behind every interaction is becoming foundational to the integrity of a digital world. Founded by Princeton PhD scientists, Mayank Agrawal and Matt Hardy, Proof of Human is a research and technology company developing the science, products, and infrastructure required to meet that challenge at global scale. As a public benefit corporation, we treat this work as both a technical frontier and a public responsibility, advancing the field while shaping the standards and governance for how human verification systems are developed, deployed, and used. **About the role** ------------------ We’re looking for a *Founding GTM* to join us to build the next phase of how Proof of Human goes to market. You’ll work directly with the founders and staff across sales, growth, and market development: generating pipeline, leading customer conversations, advancing deals, and turning both your intuition, your research, and what you learn on the front lines into sharper positioning, stronger systems, and clearer strategic direction. This is a deeply hands\-on role for someone who wants to create the playbook while running it. **What you’ll do:** ------------------- * **Market Development:** Test new industries, buyer personas, use cases, messages, and acquisition channels to determine where Proof of Human has the strongest opportunity to win. Use what you learn to recommend where the company and product should focus. * **Pipeline Generation:** Build targeted pipelines across our existing market and select new verticals through thoughtful outbound, warm introductions, events, partnerships, and other distribution channels you identify, to create a steady flow of growth opportunities. * **Customer Discovery:** Lead early conversations with prospective customers to understand their problems, priorities, urgency, decision process, and willingness to commit. Clearly communicate Proof of Human’s value to both business and technical stakeholders. * Deal Execution: Own opportunities from initial outreach through discovery, demos, pilots, pricing conversations, close and commercial follow\-up, working closely with the team to move qualified deals toward close while maintaining a consistent momentum throughout. * Sales Enablement: Create the materials that help deals move forward for you and the team, including tailored follow\-ups, pitch decks, business cases, pilot proposals, objection handling, case studies, and vertical\-specific narratives for the buyer and use case. * Growth Experimentation: Run lightweight, measurable experiments across audiences, messaging, distribution channels, and conversion points. Use the results to determine what should be scaled, changed, or stopped, and turn tests into repeatable programs . **You’ll be a good fit if:** ---------------------------- * **Nobody has to hand you a map.** There’s no established process yet for much of what this role touches. You find a starting point, try something, learn from the result, and build the next version without losing momentum as conditions change. * **You’re curious across disciplines**. Whether you’re speaking with an academic, engineer, or business executive, or entering an unfamiliar market, you want to understand the substance and communicate in the language of the person across from you. * **You move fast once you see what needs to happen.** You don’t wait for the perfect moment or someone’s blessing. You take ownership, bring other people along, and keep pushing through ambiguity, friction, and setbacks until the work is finished. * **You think in hypotheses**. You turn open\-ended questions into focused experiments, define what you need to learn, and pay attention to the evidence. When the answer changes, you adjust your approach without getting attached to the original idea.

You will work directly with the founders and engineers who turn that research into useful technology. **Location and compensation** Location: Boston/Cambridge preferred; New York City can work for an exceptional candidate. jobs.title: Marketing Lead
jobs.description: SageOx is a well\-funded, early\-stage startup at the frontier of how AI is shaping the world. At SageOx, we believe the future of work is deeply human and collaborative. As agents take on execution, coordination, and routine work, people gain space for what only humans do well: creativity, judgment, relationships, the work of imagining, deciding, and creating together. Humans become not only more productive individually, but better at working with each other, leaning on their AI coworkers to carry out execution and raise the quality of how they collaborate. We're looking for strategic hires \- fearless, creative, independent thinkers \- that will shape the future of the company, and how work is done in the modern world. There's no trail yet. Pioneering and breaking trails is one of our company's core values. You're one of the first ten people cutting it. **Why this role exists** ------------------------ You'll be the first marketer at SageOx. There is no marketing team, no agency, no brand book with rules to follow \- you’ll be the brain behind all that. We’re looking for an AI\-pilled marketer who does not get defined by boundaries and applies creativity to push through the noise. SageOx is creating a new product category, and this role is part of the creation. A category doesn't exist until people have words for it. Part of your work is finding what resonates, learning how to explain it, and teaching the market to see what we see. That work happens in two places in public: social media, where builders are comparing notes on agents every day, and events, where they meet each other and decide what's worth their attention. Your job is to make SageOx present, legible, and connected in both. This role will morph over time as needs evolve. Your ultimate goal is to drive awareness of SageOx \- that can be measured by customer acquisition, engagement on social media, and broader ecosystem reach. **Social—be where the conversation is** --------------------------------------- * **Own SageOx's voice on X and LinkedIn.** Publish on cadence, every week: threads, posts, short video, and the occasional longer piece. The raw material comes from the founders, the team's own experiments with agents, customer stories, and shipped features; you turn it into things people actually read. * **Be a real presence, where builders compare notes.** Reddit, Hacker News, and the Discords and Slacks of the agent tools themselves — the Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and MCP communities. Show up as a person, be useful, know who the interesting voices are, and be one of them. * **Run launches.** When we ship something worth announcing, own the moment end to end — Hacker News, Product Hunt, the coordinated push across every channel, and the follow\-through in the comments. * **Amplify the founders and team.** Identify the highest\-impact platforms, podcasts, and moments for the founders and other team members to show up, get them there, and shape what they say so it lands. * **Bring outside\-in signal back.** What people are asking, what they're confused by, who's comparing us to what — surfaced to the core team continuously. What you hear in public is a deliverable, not a byproduct. **Events—put SageOx in the room** --------------------------------- * **Own event presence end to end.** Pick the events worth being at across San Francisco, Seattle, and other builder hubs, and decide how we show up — talk, demo, booth, dinner, sponsorship, or just being there. * **Host our own.** Meetups, hackathons, workshops, and small dinners for the teams building with agents. Start small and repeatable; grow what works. * **Turn every event into a pipeline.** Know who's coming, who we met, and what happened after. An event that produced no conversations worth following up on is an event we shouldn't repeat. * **Build the Seattle builder scene around us.** Seattle has fewer natural gathering points for agent\-heavy teams than San Francisco. Create some. **Systematize—measure, decide, repeat** --------------------------------------- * **Instrument everything.** Define what a good week looks like — qualified signups sourced, conversations started, follow\-ups from events — and report on it in a way the team can act on. * **Run experiments, not campaigns.** A new channel, a new format, a new event type: form a hypothesis, try it, measure it, keep it or kill it. A kill is a result. * **Use agents to scale yourself.** Research, drafting, monitoring, and reporting are all agent\-assisted here. Build those workflows for yourself — without outsourcing judgment or voice to the agents. * **Use SageOx daily** and market from lived use, not talking points. **How this person operates** ---------------------------- * Driven by curiosity, courageous in experimenting, humble in success, excited for what AI enables our customers to do. * Embodies the SageOx values \- you’ll be amongst the most recognized faces associated with the company. * Ships posts and events instead of producing marketing plans without execution. * Balances speed with taste. The goal is not maximum output; it is the right message to the right builders. In the age of AI slop, that often means editing and synthesizing rather than producing more. * Comfortable in a room full of engineers and builders, or in a thread full of skeptics. Asks sharp questions, listens, and changes direction when evidence contradicts the original idea. * Is resourceful and creative, finds solutions rather than waiting to inherit them. * Works well with founders and the team, communicates progress without excessive process, and makes the next decision clearer. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- We don't care which door you came through — social, community, developer relations, events, content, or building something of your own. We care that you can make a technical product legible to the people who need it and get them to show up. * **2–7 years in developer marketing, community, DevRel, social, or events** — for a technical product with a builder audience. The title matters less than the evidence: audiences you've grown, events you've run, and what happened after. * **Mission alignment:** believes deeply in what SageOx is building. Lives and breathes the product every day, all day long. * **Complete fluency with AI:** you use AI throughout your own work, and you're curious and knowledgeable about the ecosystem — emerging technologies, products, practices. The pitch is only credible from a practitioner. * **Has personally grown an audience, a community, or a channel somewhere.** Show us. * **Has run events people wanted to come back to** — from a 10\-person dinner to a hackathon. * **Technical enough to be credible:** you can explain what an MCP server is, demo the product, and follow an engineer's answer without needing it translated. * **Thinks deeply, communicates clearly, writes well:** AI slop is all around us — stand on your own thinking, clarity, and craft. Bonus if you're good on camera. * **Strong sense of ownership:** owns outcomes; makes things happen with limited resources; has a great sense of direction and prioritization amid the ambiguity of an early\-stage startup. * **Cultural fit:** embodies SageOx's values. **Great to have** ----------------- * Already connected to the builder scene in Seattle, San Francisco, and online — you know who to invite. * An existing audience of your own among builders. * Founder or early\-employee experience somewhere that grew fast. * Experience with open\-source products or developer communities. **Location — Seattle or San Francisco, in person** -------------------------------------------------- In person, five days a week. We move fast and the work benefits enormously from being in the room. For this role, the room is often an event, and half of them are in San Francisco — so either city works, and you'll spend real time in both.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description: **About Proof of Human** ------------------------ Proof of Human is a research and deployment company building the proof\-of\-human layer in digital identity. Proof of Human seeks to produce high\-impact research and to productize this research in bot detection, fraud prevention, and continuous authentication. Proof of Human was founded in 2023 by two Princeton PhD scientists – Mayank Agrawal and Matt Hardy. They have published in Science, PNAS, Nature Human Behaviour, and Psychological Review and are backed by Y Combinator and Brickyard Ventures. **About the role** ------------------ Proof of Human provides frictionless, continual human verification. jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Data & Analytics
jobs.description: **About Us** Greenbrook Medical is building the new standard in primary care. We deliver high\-touch, relationship\-based care through neighborhood clinics, grounded in a simple belief: every senior deserves the kind of care we would want for our own families. Our model prioritizes time with patients, strong care coordination, and a personalized approach that improves outcomes while lowering total cost of care. We take full accountability for patient outcomes and overall cost of care, aligning clinical excellence with disciplined execution. That commitment shows up in our results, including a patient Net Promoter Score of 90, compared to 32 for typical healthcare organizations. Rooted in Tampa Bay and partnered with Tampa General Hospital, we are entering an exciting phase of growth. Backed by strong unit economics, experienced operators, and a proven playbook, we are looking for builders and operators who want to help scale a healthcare platform designed to deliver better care, better coordination, and better outcomes for seniors. **About The Role** We're hiring our first dedicated data person. This person will build on our existing data platform, harden it to ensure consistent performance and build upon our metric library to ensure that our operators can monitor performance across all of our levers. Success in this role means end to end ownership, from data platform to metric delivery and visualization in dashboarding tools As Data and Analytics Engineer, you own four things: * **The analytics layer**: the dbt models and business logic that turn raw data into something usable, and the metric definitions underneath them * **Reporting and BI**: the reporting layer the whole business reads from * **Our production systems**: you take ownership of systems as they come in\-house from our engineering partner, harden them, and keep making them better, with accountability for uptime \& system integrity * **The partnership with our engineering team**: you are the internal counterpart who knows both the business and the systems well enough to resolve most issues directly This is a build\-and\-own role. Our engineering partner stands up a new capability; you take it on once it is live, harden it, and keep improving it. You work as their peer rather than their coordinator. You also partner closely with the pop health team (who owns our value drivers) in defining metrics and deciding together what the business needs to see. You report to the VP of Growth and Population Health. **Location:** New York City strongly preferred (Hybrid). Open to exceptional remote candidates. **What You'll Do** Own the Analytics Layer * Build and maintain the dbt models and business logic our metrics and workflows depend on. Work within Google Cloud to iterate on our business logic and transformation infrastructure * Ensure consistency in definitions across all surfaces at Greenbrook * Work with the performance managers on what needs measuring and what good looks like in their areas Take Ownership of What's in Production * Take on systems as they move from our engineering partner into steady state, and keep them healthy * Be accountable for uptime \& system integrity – catch ingestion and pipeline issues or logic bugs and resolve them within our SLAs. Develop monitoring and uptime reporting. * Ensure a performant system. Optimize workloads and runtime * Keep improving what you take on rather than only maintaining it Partner Across the Business * Be the counterpart our engineering partner can hand production work to, resolving what you can and escalating what needs them * Build dashboards to support organizational decisionmaking * Work closely with the business – sit in the operating meetings where the data gets used, so you know what decisions it feeds **What Success Looks Like** * Data Trust: the business trusts the numbers, and you are ahead of issues rather than behind them * Reliability: systems transitioned to you stay healthy, and when they break they get fixed quickly * Coverage: the metrics our drivers depend on have a certified definition and a single source of truth * Delivery: the work you committed to for the quarter shipped * Metrics you'll own: delivery against committed quarterly work, and counterpart satisfaction among the performance managers and the Head of Population Health **About You** You bring: * Fluency in dbt and Python * Hands on experience with Health care datasets and interoperability frameworks which our business run on, including a deep understanding of claims, eligibility, EHR data, and frameworks such as FHIR and HL7 * A solid grasp of business fundamentals, enough to partner with business and clinical managers on defining metrics rather than only building to spec * Experience owning production systems, including being the person who responds when something breaks * Bachelor's degree required * A mindset grounded in our core values of Heart, Excellence, Accountability, Resilience, and Teamwork You'll stand out if you: * **Want to own a system deeply**: you would rather take something into production, harden it, and keep improving it than move on to the next greenfield build * **Get to root cause**: you find out why a number is wrong rather than patching the symptom * **Are AI\-native**: you live in modern AI tools to support your work * **Communicate with clarity**: you are comfortable explaining complex data to business users and communicate proactively * **Own the outcome**: high bias for action, follow through on commitments, and close loops without needing to be chased **Why You'll Love Working Here** **Make An Impact Every Day** Be part of a mission\-driven team transforming primary care for seniors. Your work directly supports better outcomes, better coordination, and better experiences for some of the most vulnerable patients in healthcare. **Work That Actually Matters** We're not a volume\-driven system, we're accountable for outcomes. That means your work directly contributes to quality care, patient satisfaction, and meaningful improvements in how healthcare is delivered. **Build And Grow With Us** We're building more than a company, we're building careers. As we expand, you'll have opportunities to grow your skills and take on new challenges. **Strong, Transparent Compensation \& Benefits** * $170,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications * Generous annual performance bonus * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Paid time off * 401(k) with company match **Our Selection Process** Application Initial interview Skills/experience interview Values interview Case Study and Case Study Interview References **Equal Employment Opportunity and Commitment to Diversity** At Greenbrook Medical, we believe the only way we accomplish our mission is by building the best team in healthcare. We will extend equal employment opportunity to all applicants without regard to age, race, ethnicity, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, socioeconomic background, disability status, military affiliation, pregnancy or any other status protected under federal, state and local laws. We encourage all who share our mission to apply. Greenbrook Medical will provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process. If you need additional accommodations or assistance, do not hesitate to contact our People team at recruiting@greenbrookmedical.com.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer

We are developing models that learn how complex physical systems behave and reuse that understanding across forecasts, scenarios, and operational decisions. Energy is our first proving ground. We combine historical and live data with operational context, bringing together machine learning research, data infrastructure, and software engineering to turn advances in modeling into useful technology for energy operators. Your primary ownership is the shared product and the application layer of customer deployments. You will collaborate with, rather than replace, the engineers and researchers responsible for the underlying data and models. **What you'll own** * The public product: maps, radar, assets, network views, and how they work together as one dependable application. * The path from visitor to operator: accounts and organizations, saving and claiming assets, portfolios, private\-data connections, permissions, alerts, and reports. * Product architecture, APIs, performance, observability, reliability, accessibility, and the systems that keep the application dependable. * The agent's interaction quality: how context is selected, how sources are shown, and how the product handles uncertainty, unsupported requests, and unreliable answers. * Customer\-facing workflows and application\-level integrations, working with the engineers who own the underlying data and model systems. * Direct user feedback and production debugging, turning repeated friction into clearer workflows and better software. * Decisions, with the founders and technical team, about what becomes reusable product, what remains customer\-specific, and what should not be built. **What we're looking for** * Experience owning complex, data\-rich applications from an ambiguous user need through implementation, deployment, and production operation. * Strong React and TypeScript skills, together with the backend and API experience needed to own an end\-to\-end product outcome. * Product judgment: the ability to translate complex user needs into understandable interfaces and dependable workflows. * Experience with production debugging, performance, reliability, accounts, and permissions. * The ability to work directly with customers, ask precise questions, and separate the underlying need from a requested implementation. * Clear collaboration across product, data, model, and agent boundaries without treating those boundaries as someone else's problem. Experience with maps, time\-series interfaces, or other complex, data\-rich products is particularly relevant. **First 90 days** * 30 days: Ship to production, understand the product architecture, and identify where real user sessions encounter friction or stall. * 60 days: Ship an end\-to\-end improvement that measurably improves exploration, account creation, or completion of an operator workflow. * 90 days: Own the product application and deliver a practical technical plan for the next reusable capability, informed by product usage and customer needs. **Why join** You will own a live product rather than a narrow feature area. Your work will determine how users encounter and apply our technology, from public exploration to deeper operational use, with direct influence on product architecture, interaction quality, and what we build next. **Location and compensation** Location: New York City or Boston/Cambridge. This is a hybrid role — we expect in\-person collaboration 2–3 days per week. Salary range: $180,000–$260,000 USD.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
jobs.description: **About Dental Intelligence** We are the leading player in the SaaS analytics and workflow space for dental practices, launched in 2015 to help dentists manage and grow their practices. Our best\-in\-class tech makes it more fulfilling to be a dental professional and easier to be a patient. Nearly 9,000 dental practices utilize our platform to practice smarter, generating an average top\-line production increase of 50% in the first 12 months. Whether a practice wants a comprehensive 2\-year growth plan or simply a more effective Morning Huddle, we take the busy work out of growth. Our platform helps practices find patients, schedule them, follow up, collect payments, file their forms, design their treatment plans, and so much more. We seek an experienced Sr Site Reliability Engineer who can help our organization to mature and scale the infrastructure behind our multi\-cloud SaaS platform. If the profile below sounds like you \- let’s talk! **About The Role:** We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to help us mature and scale the infrastructure behind our multi\-cloud SaaS platform. Most of our footprint runs on Microsoft Azure, built from the ground up around cloud architecture principles: autoscaling App Service and Container Apps workloads, VM Scale Sets, and Kafka\-based event streaming form the backbone. We also have a smaller, well\-run presence on AWS, and a Windows\-based on\-premises component that sits at the core of our product and integrates with our cloud environment. This role is primarily focused on Azure, where the biggest opportunity for impact lives, and you'll work across the full multi\-cloud picture. We'd like to see the on\-prem and cloud sides operate as a more unified, well\-integrated system than they do today, and that integration work is part of what makes this role interesting. This is a high\-impact role for someone who thinks in terms of systems rather than tickets, and who treats infrastructure like software. You'll have significant ownership over how our cloud infrastructure is architected, provisioned, secured, and operated going forward. If you get energized by taking a fast\-growing environment and giving it real architectural rigor (consistent patterns, full infrastructure\-as\-code coverage, sane permission models, and cost discipline), this role was built for you. We're looking for someone who wants to build the operating model, establish the standards, and lead the transformation. You should bring genuine software engineering discipline to how that infrastructure work gets done: everything in git, everything reviewed, everything automated. No snowflakes, no manual changes made "just this once." **Location:** This is a fully remote role available to candidates located in U.S. states where Dental Intelligence currently has employees. **What You'll do:*** Own the reliability, scalability, and security posture of our Azure environment end\-to\-end * Lead the effort to bring our infrastructure fully under Terraform\-managed IaC, replacing manual and ad\-hoc provisioning with repeatable, version\-controlled deployments * Treat infrastructure code like production software: everything lives in git, changes go through pull requests and peer review, and modules are tested before they ship * Define and implement a coherent Azure architecture strategy, including resource organization, naming and tagging standards, subscription and management group hierarchy, and network topology * Redesign and enforce least\-privilege access and permission boundaries across Azure RBAC, Entra ID, and service principals * Identify and eliminate wasteful or redundant resource provisioning, and build cost visibility and accountability into how infrastructure is deployed * Build CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure changes so that plan/apply, validation, and policy checks are automated rather than run by hand * Build monitoring, alerting, and observability practices (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, App Insights, or equivalent) that give the team real signal * Manage and modernize the Windows\-based on\-prem component that sits at the core of our product, and work to integrate it more tightly with our Azure environment * Bring the same IaC and automation discipline to bear on our AWS footprint as needed, keeping it as clean and well\-run as it is today * Drive incident response, postmortems, and reliability engineering practices such as SLOs, error budgets, and capacity planning * Partner closely with engineering teams to bake reliability, security, and IaC discipline into the software delivery lifecycle * Mentor other engineers on cloud, IaC, and software engineering best practices, raising the bar across the team **What You Bring:*** 6\+ years in SRE, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering roles, with deep, hands\-on Azure experience * Strong, demonstrable Terraform expertise is required. You should be comfortable designing module structures, managing state, and using Terraform to manage complex, multi\-resource environments from scratch * A genuine cloud mentality: you default to automation, reproducibility, and IaC over manual changes, and you get uncomfortable when infrastructure can't be traced back to code * A real software engineering mindset applied to infrastructure: fluency with git workflows (branching, PRs, code review), a bias toward automating anything done more than once, and discomfort with manual, undocumented changes * Experience with Windows Server administration, IIS, Active Directory/Entra ID, and Windows\-based application stacks, which are critical for the on\-prem component at the core of our product * Solid understanding of Azure networking (VNets, peering, private endpoints, NSGs), identity (Entra ID, RBAC, service principals and managed identities), and cost management tooling * Working knowledge of AWS core services (IAM, VPC, EC2/ECS, etc.) sufficient to support and extend an already well\-architected environment * Experience integrating on\-premises infrastructure with cloud environments (VPN/ExpressRoute, hybrid identity, hybrid networking) * A track record of introducing structure and standards into environments that grew organically or quickly; you enjoy imposing order, not just maintaining it * Strong scripting ability (PowerShell and/or Bash/Python) * Excellent judgment around security and access control; you think in terms of least privilege by default * Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, including making architectural calls and driving them through to adoption **Nice to Have:*** Familiarity with CI/CD tooling (Azure DevOps) for infrastructure pipelines * Prior experience leading a cloud environment from an ungoverned state to a well\-architected one * Relevant certifications (Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator, HashiCorp Terraform Associate) **What You'll Love About Dental Intelligence:*** Flexible Paid Time Off \+ 10 company\-wide paid holidays * Competitive Medical, Dental \& vision offerings, with buy up plan options, AND we match your HSA contributions. * Fully Paid Parental Leave * 401K Retirement savings plan with company match up to 5\.5% of your earnings\+ unlimited access to personal financial advisors. * Learning \& Development Reimbursement program * Company paid Life, Disability \& AD\&D * Mental Health support programs, Cellphone \& Gym membership Discounts, Corporate Sundance Passes, and more! **Please Note:** All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of a background check, which may include verification of education, employment history, and other credentials. jobs.description: Software Engineer, Internal Platforms is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. jobs.title: Sr. Five9 CCaaS Implementation Engineer
jobs.description: About Lion Mountain Lion Mountain is a professional services firm focused entirely on Five9 contact center implementations and migrations. We help mid\-market and enterprise customers move from legacy on\-premise systems and competing CCaaS platforms onto Five9, design the solution that actually fits their business, and stay with them through go\-live and beyond. We were Five9’s High Performance Demand Partner of 2025, and are on track to repeat for 2026\. We are a small, senior team that wins on depth, not volume. Our customers hire us because of our in\-depth Five9 knowledge, we treat their CRM and telephony stack like our own, and we do not hand work off to junior resources. Every engineer here owns customer outcomes end to end. The Role We are hiring an Implementation Engineer who can act as the lead Five9 solution architect on customer engagements. You will own implementations from discovery through go\-live: scoping the work, designing the call flows and integrations, configuring the Five9 environment, integrating it with the customer’s CRM, training their team, and standing behind it after launch. This is a customer\-facing, hands\-on role. You will be the technical expert in the room — the person the customer’s operations lead, IT lead, and CX leader all turn to. You will be backed by a small team of senior peers, with room to shape how we deliver as we grow. What You’ll DoLead Five9 implementations end to end * Run discovery workshops with customer business and technical stakeholders to capture current\-state contact center flows, pain points, and target outcomes. * Translate business requirements into a Five9 solution design — IVR / IVA flows, ACD and skills\-based routing, queues, dispositions, campaigns, reporting, WFM/WFO, and quality management. * Configure and deploy Five9: agent profiles, skills, campaigns, IVR scripts, prompts, DNIS / ANI mapping, dial plans, dispositions, supervisor and reporting setup. * Lead migration from legacy platforms (Genesys, NICE CXone, Avaya, Cisco, Twilio Flex, Amazon Connect, etc.) into Five9 with minimal disruption. * Own UAT, cutover planning, training, and go\-live and post go\-live support. Architect and build CRM integrations * Design and implement CRM integrations between Five9 and customer systems, including Salesforce, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, ServiceTitan, ImproveIt360, ServiceNow, etc.. and proprietary platforms. * Configure screen pop, click\-to\-dial, automated activity logging, and workflow triggers between Five9 and the CRM. * Where adapters are not enough, build custom integrations using the Five9 Agent API, REST/SOAP web services, VCC Agent Desktop Toolkit, and webhooks. * Partner with customer admins and developers to make the integration sustainable after we leave. Serve as the solution architect on each engagement * Own the technical design document and architecture diagrams for each project. * Make trade\-off decisions on routing strategy, IVR design, reporting model, security model, and integration approach — and clearly explain those trade\-offs to the customer. * Anticipate failure modes: telephony carrier handoffs, peak\-volume scaling, disaster recovery, security and compliance constraints (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2\). * Quality\-check the build before it ever goes in front of the customer. Be the trusted technical voice with the customer * Lead status calls, design reviews, and executive readouts. * Translate fluently between contact center operations, IT, and executive leadership audiences. * Push back constructively when a customer ask will create long\-term pain — and bring an alternative. Make Lion Mountain better * Contribute to our implementation playbooks, reusable templates, and integration patterns. * Mentor peers on tricky Five9 features and integration approaches. * Share what you learn in the field so the whole team gets sharper with every engagement. What We’re Looking ForRequired * Hands\-on Five9 implementation experience. You have personally configured and deployed Five9 for production customers — not just observed or supported it. * Deep familiarity with core Five9 capabilities: IVR / IVA, ACD, campaigns (inbound, outbound, blended), skills\-based routing, Supervisor, reporting, WFA and APIs. * Working knowledge of Five9 Studio 7 / IVR scripting and the Five9 Agent Desktop Plus / VCC Agent. * Experience integrating Five9 with at least 2 major CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, ServiceTitan, ServiceNow, or similar) in production. * Strong understanding of contact center fundamentals: queueing, occupancy, AHT, SLAs, abandonment, blended outbound, compliance dialing (TCPA), call recording requirements. * Solid grasp of telephony concepts: SIP, DIDs, toll\-free, number porting, carrier handoffs, codecs, network requirements for VoIP quality. * Comfort with web technologies used in integrations: REST APIs, JSON, OAuth, webhooks, basic JavaScript. Reading and writing API calls is part of the job. * Excellent customer\-facing communication. You can run a workshop, write a design doc, and present to a VP — in the same week. * Self\-direction. You can own a project end to end without daily oversight. * US\-based and authorized to work in the US without sponsorship. Strongly preferred * Five9 Professional Services or Five9 Partner experience. * Five9 certifications (Implementation, Administrator, IVA, or specialty tracks). * Salesforce Service Cloud admin experience or Salesforce certification. * Experience migrating customers from Genesys, NICE CXone, Avaya, Cisco UCCE/UCCX, or Amazon Connect onto Five9\. * Experience with Five9 Intelligent Virtual Agent (IVA), Agent Assist, and AI / NLU concepts. * Experience in regulated industries: financial services, healthcare, insurance, or BPO. * Light scripting in Python or Node.js for integration glue. jobs.title: Electrical Engineer 2 4P/848
jobs.description: **Title:** Electrical Engineer II **Client:** Alabama Power **Location:** Birmingham, AL **Contract:** 3 Years **Work Arrangement:** Hybrid – In office at least 3 days per week / 12 days per month Job Summary We are seeking an **Electrical Engineer II** to support the **Schatz Grid Visualization and Analytics Center (SGVAC)** within Southern Company’s Research \& Development organization. This role will focus on the development, maintenance, and application of **power system digital twins** , grid modeling and simulation, advanced analytics, and emerging electric grid technologies. The engineer will support research projects involving transmission and distribution systems, real\-time simulation, hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, and grid modernization technologies. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with **PSS®E, PSCAD™, RTDS® and/or OPAL\-RT®, power system modeling, EMT studies, and digital twin development** . Key Responsibilities * Develop, maintain, and apply **power system digital twins** for grid planning, operations, training, technology evaluation, and decision support. * Build, validate, and enhance transmission and distribution system models. * Conduct: + Steady\-state studies + Dynamic simulations + Electromagnetic transient (EMT) studies + Real\-time simulations * Utilize **PSS®E, PSCAD™, RTDS®, and/or OPAL\-RT®** for modeling and simulation. * Develop and support **hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL)** testing environments. * Integrate operational, planning, asset, and measurement data into digital twin and analytical applications. * Evaluate emerging grid technologies and develop technical recommendations. * Support research projects, pilot deployments, and technology demonstrations. * Collaborate with utilities, universities, national laboratories, research organizations, and technology vendors. * Prepare technical reports, presentations, publications, and project documentation. * Present technical findings and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders. Required Qualifications * **Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited college or university required.** * Strong knowledge of **electric power system analysis, modeling, simulation, and operation** . * Demonstrated experience developing and applying power system digital twins. * Proficiency with **PSS®E and PSCAD™** . * Experience with **RTDS® and/or OPAL\-RT®** for real\-time simulation and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing. * Experience conducting steady\-state, dynamic, EMT, and real\-time simulation studies. * Experience integrating operational, planning, asset, and measurement data into modeling and analytical environments. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Qualifications * Master’s concentration in **Power Systems, Electric Energy Systems, Controls, Computer Engineering, or related discipline** . * Experience with **PMUs, synchrophasors, SCADA, EMS, DERMS, or digital substations** . * Programming experience with **Python, MATLAB, C\#, Java, or similar languages** . * Familiarity with databases, data analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. * Experience working with electric utilities, research organizations, universities, national laboratories, or technology vendors. * **Professional Engineer (PE) license or ability to obtain licensure** preferred. Key Skills **Power Systems \| Digital Twin \| PSS/E \| PSCAD \| RTDS \| OPAL\-RT \| EMT \| Power System Modeling \| Grid Simulation \| Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop \| Transmission \| Distribution \| SCADA \| EMS \| DERMS \| PMU \| Synchrophasors \| Python \| MATLAB \| Grid Modernization \| R\&D**

What sets us apart is the breadth and depth of our integrated platform — we offer the most comprehensive compliance technology platform on the market integrating over a dozen purpose\-built modules. Our competitors offer only one or two. **We also operate on a unique User/Provider Model:** our technology is used not only by our clients but also internally across our managed services and advisory practices. Whether you’re an early\-career developer or a seasoned architect, you’ll help shape a next\-generation platform at the intersection of finance, technology and AI. We’re looking for voracious learners, intuitive problem solvers, and people who are just as interested in understanding the “why” behind the business as the “how” behind the code. If you’re intensely curious and driven to master both technology and the domain it serves, ACA is the place to do it. Key Responsibilities Design and implement cloud\-native software used by top\-tier financial institutions. Work across the stack — from front\-end UX to back\-end services and infrastructure. Collaborate with product managers, compliance experts, and clients to solve high\-impact problems. Apply AI and automation thoughtfully, always keeping human context in the loop. Engage in continuous learning — about new tech, financial markets, and emerging regulatory challenges. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing applications with .NET/C\#. Experience building modern front\-end applications using Angular or React. Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS and/or Microsoft Azure. Familiarity with microservices, APIs, and cloud\-native application development. Who You Are Intensely curious and motivated by the pursuit of mastery — at the intersection of technology and finance. A self\-starter who thrives in fast\-paced, collaborative environments. Excited by the complexity of financial systems and the opportunity to build tools that make them safer and more efficient. Experienced in software development, but not limited by title or background—we care more about how you think than what’s on your résumé. Our Technology Our platform is a fully cloud\-native, globally distributed SaaS solution architected for scale, security, and flexibility. We use a modern stack of containerized microservices, real\-time data pipelines, and API\-first services designed for extensibility. We embed AI throughout the platform, powering automation, intelligent risk detection, and smarter workflows — always with a human\-in\-the\-loop to ensure quality and accountability. Our software supports a wide array of compliance functions including surveillance, testing, marketing review, and more. Tap in. Build smart. Move fast. We’re hiring. **What working at ACA offers:** We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options as well as a flexible work environment. You’ll also be granted time off for designated ACA Paid Holidays, Summer Fridays, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being. We also offer unique benefits such as Student Debt Forgiveness and Pet Insurance. **About ACA:** ACA Group is the leading governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) advisor in financial services. We empower our clients to reimagine GRC and protect and grow their business. Our innovative approach integrates consulting, managed services, and our ComplianceAlpha® technology platform with the specialized expertise of former regulators and practitioners and our deep understanding of the global regulatory landscape. **What we commit to:** ACA is firmly committed to a policy of nondiscrimination, which applies to recruiting, hiring, placement, promotions, training, discipline, terminations, layoffs, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation and all other terms and conditions of employment. jobs.title: EDI Service Specialist I
jobs.description: **You are:** A member of the Connection Services team within Client Operations. You are responsible for monitoring the exchange of demographic and enrollment data between the WorkforceNow module and our customers’ third\-party vendors (e.g., payroll processors, insurance carriers, third party administrators, etc.). **You will:** Support the Comprehensive Services team and clients by maintaining and troubleshooting any EDI/Carrier Connection errors that present themselves for clients and cases aligned to you. You will also work with internal partners, carriers, brokers and the client to support Open Enrollment throughout the year, especially at year\-end by updating and scheduling OE files to ensure enrollments are submitted to the client’s benefit carriers timely. **You will need:** **Carrier Connections/EDI Competency:** * Monitor the status of connections that have been moved to a production status for the book of business assigned to you (if applicable). * Support maintenance and troubleshooting of WorkforceNow EDI/Carrier Connections. * When presented with a case to troubleshoot, investigate and resolve issues/defects with existing code. * Communicate status and next steps to all partners (internal, carrier, client, broker, etc.) throughout the lifecycle of a case through constant updates to the active case. * Partner with Account Managers, Engineers, and client to determine best practices for the setup of the EDI. * Serve as a technical resource for Account Managers and Customer Service Representatives who may have questions regarding active connections/EDI. * Participate in conference calls with clients, carriers, brokers, sales, and/or prospects with connection questions. * Maintain primary contact information for each third\-party vendor with whom we have a connection. * Work with these contacts to track new release dates for their systems, obtain updated file specifications, and identify the impact of any changes on existing connections. * Make modifications to existing connection code as requested by client. * Test connections to ensure accuracy of transmission of data. * Maintain comprehensive understanding of and take responsibility for continuous learning of new technologies and templates being introduced in the EDI/Connections environment. * Support monthly Open Enrollment renewals by updating files in Production and schedule “OE” files, which will especially be priority at year\-end when \~70% of your book of business will be renewing their benefits. **Behaviors:** * Adaptability * Alignment * Collaboration * Ethics/Integrity * Innovation * Process \& Project Management * Results Orientation * Service Orientation / Client Focus **Technical Skills:** * Proficient in MS Excel skills such as creating pivot tables, v\-lookups to compare files and data to identify discrepancies between two files. * Knowledge of Salesforce is helpful for case and project management. **QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED:** * Experience working in a software and/or service company environment. **Preference will be given to candidates who have the following:** * SQL * 1\-2 years of benefits experience. * EDI experience Base salary offers for this position may vary based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. Some positions may include additional compensation in the form of bonus, equity or commissions. We offer the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Matched Retirement Savings, Wellness Program, Short\-and Long\-Term Disability, Charitable Contribution Match, Holidays, Personal Days \& Vacation, Paid Volunteer Time Off, and more. The compensation for this role is USD $18\.56 \- USD $34\.66 / Hour\* * Actual compensation will not be less than the applicable minimum wage or minimum exempt salary requirement under federal, state and local laws. **A little about ADP:** We are a comprehensive global provider of cloud\-based human capital management (HCM) solutions that unite HR, payroll, talent, time, tax and benefits administration and a leader in business outsourcing services, analytics, and compliance expertise. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating a down\-to\-earth culture that embraces our core values, welcomes ideas, encourages innovation, and values belonging. jobs.title: Staff Back End Engineer
jobs.description: **About Altruist** Altruist is transforming the multi\-trillion dollar wealth management industry by building an AI platform for wealth professionals. We partner with financial advisors nationwide, empowering them to grow, optimize time and resources, and deliver superior outcomes for their clients. We're looking for exceptional talent to help us achieve our mission of making financial advice better, more affordable, and accessible to all. If you're passionate about challenging the status quo and want to do the most important work of your life, we'd love to meet you! **But first, our values** **Kindness** \- Kindness doesn't *just* equal niceness. We listen to understand. We embrace, and encourage healthy debate and diverse perspectives. We approach conflict openly, honestly, and respectfully. **Brilliance** \- Humility is the skill we're most proud of and possessing a growth mindset is always top of mind. We take ownership in everything we touch; regularly using our unique superpowers to reach a common goal as a team. We succeed and fail as one. **Grit** \- When challenges arise, we stay laser focused on achieving our mission and finding a way forward, even when it's hard. Apply Now** ------------------------- Send your resume and a brief cover letter to careers@aspnix.com with the position title in the subject line.
