Equal employment opportunity will be extended to all persons in all aspects of employment, including retirement, hiring, training, promotion, transfer, compensation, benefits, discipline and termination.*** ***Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies:*** *Faegre Drinker Biddle \& Reath (and any subsidiary) has an internal recruiting department and does not accept unsolicited resumes.*

jobs.title: Chief Information & AI Officer
jobs.description: **Chief Information \& AI Officer** Location: hybrid Atlanta, San Diego \& Orlando • Full\-time, Executive • Reports to the President Every lender in the country can buy the same AI models on the same afternoon. Almost none of them have worked out how to put those models to work in a business where a wrong answer is a regulatory event — and, for the owner on the other end, a payroll that does not get made. That is the job. FairSquare is looking for a Chief Information \& AI Officer to lead our technology organization — and to build something most companies our size are still only talking about. You will own the full technology stack: software engineering, data, infrastructure, security and IT. On top of that, you will own a harder question. In a small\-business lending company, which work should AI simply do? Which should AI draft, with a named human accountable for the result? And which should never leave human hands at all? Your answer has to hold up three ways at once — for a regulator, for a funding partner, and for the business owner waiting on a decision. Nobody is going to hand you that answer. You will be the executive who collaborates with the team to define it, builds the operating model and the guardrails that make it real, defends it to the Board and to our regulators and funding partners, and then proves — with evidence, not anecdotes — that it works. You will raise the obstacles early, while they are still cheap to fix, and own the outcome either way. If you believe the durable advantage in AI belongs to the companies that make it accountable rather than the ones that adopt it first, we should talk. **About FairSquare** FairSquare is a technology\-driven financial services company serving small businesses across the United States. We began with a singular focus to bring accessible working capital to our nation's small businesses and have evolved into a full suite of financial products and the ability to cater to every business need. We combine capital, data and technology to get funding into the hands of business owners quickly and responsibly. Founded in 1999, our subsidiary brands offer a range of diverse financing options from premier small business loans to self\-service digital lending platforms that support the needs of our customers throughout every stage of their business journey. **The Role** Reporting directly to the President and serving on the executive leadership team, the Chief Information \& AI Officer sets and drives FairSquare's combined technology and artificial intelligence strategy — ensuring our software, infrastructure and AI systems run efficiently, profitably, securely and responsibly. This is a builder's seat, not a caretaker's. You will make executive technology and AI decisions on behalf of the company: owning the technology and AI budget, aligning investment with our vision and our stakeholders' needs, sequencing AI use cases against a risk\-tiered framework, and uniting software engineering, data science, AI and IT into one team that can actually execute against the strategy you set. You will also lead it the way we expect every leader at FairSquare to lead — commitments owned and delivered on time, problems surfaced before they become surprises, disagreement voiced at the table rather than after the meeting, and full commitment carried forward once a decision is made. **What You Will Do** Set the technology and AI strategy for the enterprise, and keep it tied to our Key Goals and business outcomes rather than to tooling. Find and deploy the technologies — including AI and machine learning — that create genuine competitive advantage in fintech, and say no to the ones that do not. Curiosity about what is new, discipline about what is worth it. Stand up and lead an AI Center of Excellence: the central hub that sets standards, shared tooling and playbooks for AI leads embedded across the business — and that spreads what works instead of letting it stay in one team. Prioritize and sequence AI use cases enterprise\-wide against a risk\-tiered framework, distinguishing what can be automated outright from what requires human oversight or human judgment alone — and deciding in the customer's favor when the trade\-off is close. Build the governance that makes speed defensible — model risk management, data protection, quality assurance, fair\-lending and regulatory compliance, and explainability and audit standards for AI output. Own system infrastructure end to end: functionality, resilience, security, and the platforms our AI work depends on. Define and report the measures that matter — adoption, accuracy, override and correction rates, cycle\-time impact and return on investment — and carry that story, good news and bad, to the President and the Board. Partner across every function to put technology and AI to profitable use: treat internal colleagues as customers, go to the person rather than around them, name the friction you find in a process instead of quietly working around it, and use what you hear back to adjust course. Coach, develop and retain a distributed team of software, data science, AI and IT professionals — keeping real development plans in place for your leaders and yourself, and working with HR on the AI fluency, reskilling and change management that enterprise AI adoption genuinely requires. Lead in line with our policies and applicable law: hiring and training, planning and directing work, and developing and rewarding performance. **What You Bring** A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science or a related field; a master's or PhD in AI/ML is preferred. At least 10 years in technology roles, including hands\-on exposure to AI/ML or data science, and at least 5 years leading people. A track record of owning budgets and business planning at scale — and of delivering what you committed to, on the date you committed to it. Strategic range — the ability to set a direction across both the technology and the AI domains, then execute it: consulting widely before you decide, and moving with real urgency once you have. Deep technical knowledge of cloud platforms, mobile applications and generative AI, and a clear sense of how they apply to financial services and lending. Real experience with AI governance, model risk management and regulatory compliance — including fair\-lending regulation (for example ECOA / Regulation B) and data privacy. Communication skill that travels: you can explain an AI capability, and its risk, to an engineer and to a director in the same week — and you disagree openly before a decision is made rather than relitigating it afterward. Leadership and organizational ability across a distributed, cross\-functional operating model, with a record of growing people and not only shipping projects — the leaders you have developed are the evidence. Sound judgment about when AI is the right answer — the confidence to say when it is not, and the self\-awareness to name your own blind spots before someone else does. **Why This Role Is Different** Most technology executives inherit a roadmap. You will inherit a mandate. FairSquare has made a deliberate decision to treat AI as an operating\-model question rather than a procurement one — which means the person in this seat gets to redesign how work actually moves through the company, not just buy the software that supports it. Executive leadership and the Board are already engaged and expect to be held to evidence. The budget is real. The scope is the enterprise. It is also a role with a conscience attached. Every role here touches a customer, and the standard we hold ourselves to is that we can always explain how a decision was made and who was accountable for it. Small businesses risk it all for a dream; we risk it all to make sure they win. If that constraint reads to you as the interesting part of the problem rather than the annoying part, you are the person we are looking for. **Compensation \& Location** Salary range: Base Salary: $290K\-375K. Position eligible for additional incentives including bonus, equity, 401(k) match, health and welfare benefits, amazing culture, growth opportunity and more. Location: This position is a Hybrid role and will work from our offices in either: San Diego, CA; Atlanta, GA, or Orlando, FL. FairSquare is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Unified Experience
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. **About the Role** Support Fanatics Collect's Unified Experience initiative, building seamless collector journeys across Fanatics Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, Topps, and future experiences. Today a collector can win a card in a live show, rip a pack, buy on the marketplace, and store it all in a vault — but those moments still feel like separate products. Your job is to make them feel like one. That means building the shared surfaces, APIs, and front\-end systems that connect experiences that were each built independently, and doing it without slowing any of them down. This is a hands\-on senior role. You'll own meaningful slices of the unified experience end to end — schema to API to UI — and you'll do it alongside a Staff Backend Engineer, mobile engineers, product, and design. **Why Join Us** Fanatics Collect is growing fast, and the unification work is the highest\-leverage engineering investment we have: every new app, drop, and live format gets easier once the shared foundation exists. You'll work across mobile, web, and internal tools, with real autonomy and a short path from idea to production. Your teammates are passionate about the space and most of them are collectors themselves. **Product Context and Scale** Our surfaces reach millions of collectors across iOS, Android, and web, with live, high\-traffic moments (breaks, drops, auctions closing) that make performance and reliability non\-negotiable. You'll be working in a landscape of multiple existing products with real users and real data, so migration, backward compatibility, and careful rollout are part of the craft. **First 90 Days** * Ship a meaningful, user\-facing piece of the unified experience end to end. * Build a working map of how Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, and Topps actually fit together today — data models, identity, entitlements, and the seams between them. * Establish working relationships with the backend, mobile, product, and design partners you'll depend on. * Identify one piece of duplicated or divergent logic across surfaces and make the case for consolidating it. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain fullstack features using Python, FastAPI, Next.js, React, and TypeScript. * Build scalable, performant, highly available services and interfaces on AWS and Vercel. * Own features end to end: data model, API contract, front\-end implementation, tests, rollout, and post\-launch metrics. * Build and maintain reusable front\-end components, APIs, and shared libraries that multiple apps (web and mobile) depend on — and treat other engineers as first\-class consumers of what you build. * Contribute to cross\-surface concerns like shared identity, entitlements, inventory, and navigation between collector experiences. * Ship behind feature flags with instrumentation in place, and use the resulting data to decide what to keep, fix, or cut. * Prototype quickly with Product and Design when a working demo will settle a debate faster than a document. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, LLM\-backed workflows) to raise your own throughput, and share what works with the team. * Write meaningful tests across the stack — unit, integration, and E2E — using Playwright, Jest, React Testing Library, and Pytest, and keep CI/CD pipelines trustworthy. * Maintain component documentation and interaction specs via Storybook. * Participate in sprint planning, retros, and product strategy sessions; raise scope and sequencing concerns early rather than at the end. * Mentor engineers through code review and pairing, and raise the bar on code structure, testing, and documentation. **Requirements** * 5\+ years of professional fullstack development experience, with demonstrated proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Python, plus hands\-on cloud experience (AWS preferred). * Strong grasp of architectural patterns, API design, and application performance tuning — and the judgment to know when a simpler solution is the right one. * Track record of owning features end to end in production, including the parts after launch: monitoring, debugging, and iterating on real user behavior. * Solid front\-end fundamentals: responsive UI development, accessibility (a11y), and front\-end performance practices. * Experience with state management patterns and tools such as React Context, Zustand, Redux, or XState, and a thoughtful approach to complexity in large apps. * Strong testing discipline with tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, or Pytest. * Experience with Git and modern CI/CD practices. * Comfortable working across domains — backend APIs, customer\-facing web, mobile web, and internal tools — and context switching without dropping threads. * Clear written and verbal communication; able to work directly with Product, Design, and other engineering teams and drive alignment on your own work. * Experience using or a genuine appetite for AI developer tooling to improve velocity. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. **Nice to Have** * Experience integrating or consolidating multiple existing products, including data migrations against live users. * Experience with high\-traffic, real\-time, or live\-event product surfaces. * Background in growth engineering or rapid experimentation frameworks. * Experience in e\-commerce, marketplaces, or gaming live ops. * Design system or shared component library ownership. * Passion for collecting, trading, sports, or gaming — and an interest in being a user of what you build. If you like owning problems end to end, care about how software feels and not just whether it works, and want your work used daily by millions of collectors — we'd love to talk. *Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don't fall victim to fraud. Fanatics never seeks payment from job applicants. Feel free to ask your recruiter for a phone call or other type of communication for interview, and ensure your communication is coming from a Fanatics email address (including @collectfanatics.com). For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at* *www.fanaticsinc.com/careers* By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: This is an opportunity for a Data Platform Engineer within First Orion’s Data Engineering organization. This hands\-on role is responsible for implementing, automating, operating, and improving our enterprise data platform, with a primary focus on Databricks running on AWS. The engineer will translate platform architecture and governance standards into reliable infrastructure, deployments, access controls, pipelines, and internal data solutions. You will work closely with the Data Platform Architect, who sets platform direction, architecture, and company process alignment. The Data Platform Engineer provides implementation expertise, builds according to those designs, and owns the operational quality of the platform. We are looking for a collaborative, self\-motivated engineer with strong technical judgment and a commitment to secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions. ### **What you’ll be doing:** * Implement, operate, and continuously improve the Databricks platform on AWS * Build and maintain Terraform modules for Databricks, AWS infrastructure, Unity Catalog, permissions, and supporting integrations * Develop and maintain Databricks Asset Bundles and CI/CD pipelines for repeatable deployments across environments * Configure and support workspaces, compute policies, SQL warehouses, workflows, jobs, service principals, and platform permissions * Implement Unity Catalog governance, including catalogs, schemas, storage credentials, external locations, ownership, and group\-based access * Build and support foundational data pipelines using Python, SQL, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and Databricks workflows * Develop lightweight internal applications and governed user\-input solutions using approved platform services * Monitor platform health, reliability, performance, security, and cost; troubleshoot incidents and complete root\-cause analysis * Create reusable patterns, automation, runbooks, and self\-service capabilities for engineering teams * Partner with the Data Platform Architect to validate designs, identify risks, and support production\-readiness reviews ### **What you’ll need:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or a related discipline * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with Databricks and Apache Spark in production environments * Strong Terraform experience, including modules, state management, provider configuration, and CI/CD * Strong knowledge of Unity Catalog, including securable objects, ownership, privilege inheritance, and governance models * Strong AWS experience, particularly IAM, S3, networking, encryption, monitoring, and secure service integration * Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles, Git\-based development, automated testing, and deployment pipelines * Strong Python and SQL skills with working knowledge of PySpark, Delta Lake, and distributed data processing * Experience with identity and access management, service principals, groups, least privilege, and SSO/SCIM * Experience with platform observability, troubleshooting, incident response, performance tuning, and cost optimization * Ability to translate architecture and governance requirements into maintainable code, automation, and operating procedures * Strong communication and collaboration skills across architecture, engineering, security, and business teams ### **Bonus Points:** * Experience migrating Hive Metastore or DBFS\-based workloads to Unity Catalog * Experience with Databricks Apps, Streamlit, REST APIs, or lightweight Python applications * Databricks or AWS certifications * Experience with FinOps, Delta Sharing, AI/ML platforms, or high\-scale telecom data systems **Company Benefits:** Balancing the work\-life flow is key to health and happiness! That is why we offer one of the most competitive packages in our industry with open PTO, company paid holidays, Flex Fridays and flexible work arrangements. We strongly value the health and wellness of our teammates and through our state\-of\-the\-art fitness center we’re helping our teammates reach their wellness goals while at work. jobs.title: Senior Applied Data Scientist, Fleet Intelligence
jobs.description: A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation! **More about our team and company:** Fleetio is looking for a product\-minded Senior Applied Data Scientist to join our Fleet Intelligence team. You will help turn years of fleet maintenance and operational data into trusted, actionable intelligence that helps customers anticipate what is ahead and make better decisions about usage, cost, availability, maintenance risk, and asset lifecycle. This is an applied role at the intersection of data science, machine learning, analytics engineering, and product development. You will work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Software Engineers, and Data partners to identify valuable prediction problems, develop practical models, and bring them into customer\-facing workflows. Your goal is to deliver intelligence that changes a decision, arrives early enough to act on, and communicates uncertainty honestly. Your initial mandate will be grounded in confirmed Fleet Intelligence work: utilization and tire intelligence, ROI measurement, existing predictive models, and the analytics foundations needed to support customer\-facing intelligence. You will assess current model quality, establish credible baselines, and help the team ship useful capabilities while strengthening its data\-science practices. Over time, you will help evaluate and shape opportunities for Predictive Fleet Intelligence, including projection, anticipation, and risk inference. You will help determine which opportunities are technically credible, valuable to customers, and ready to become durable product investments. ### **More About Our Team and Company** * Watch our culture videos: https://fleet.io/culture * Engineering culture, interview process, and videos: https://www.fleetio.com/careers/engineering * More about the Fleetio platform: https://www.fleetio.com/features * API docs: https://developer.fleetio.com *This is a remote opportunity and is open to candidates in the United States, Canada, or Mexico.* **Who You Are** --------------- You are an applied data scientist who enjoys working on ambiguous, high\-value product problems. You can translate a customer or business decision into a measurable modeling problem, establish a credible baseline, and iteratively improve it. You know when straightforward statistics or deterministic projection is the right answer and when a machine learning approach is warranted. You care deeply about correctness, explainability, and trust. You are comfortable communicating confidence intervals, limitations, and data gaps to technical and non\-technical partners. You collaborate well with software and data engineers, but you can independently explore data, build production\-quality models, define evaluation methods, and guide how model outputs should appear in a product experience. You are pragmatic, product\-minded, and outcome\-oriented. You would rather ship a useful, well\-calibrated forecast than an impressive model that does not change a customer decision. **Your Impact** --------------- * Help deliver near\-term Fleet Intelligence initiatives, including tire intelligence, utilization intelligence, ROI measurement, existing predictive models, and the analytical foundations that support customer\-facing intelligence. * Evaluate and develop credible projections or predictive models for fleet usage, maintenance cost, availability, condition and failure risk, and asset lifecycle decisions as product direction and evidence mature. * Translate product questions into clear hypotheses, target variables, baselines, evaluation plans, and incremental delivery milestones. * Explore Fleetio’s maintenance, usage, cost, work\-order, telematics, warranty, and asset\-history data to identify predictive signals and material data gaps. * Build, validate, and operationalize models from experimentation through production monitoring and iteration. * Define model\-quality metrics, confidence thresholds, drift detection, and feedback loops appropriate to the cost and reversibility of the customer decision. * Partner with Product and Design to make model outputs understandable, explainable, and actionable inside the workflows where customers already make decisions. * Establish reusable practices for experimentation, model documentation, validation, monitoring, and responsible claims about predictive performance. * Communicate findings, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical partners, product leaders, and executives. * Share knowledge through design reviews, documentation, pairing, and mentorship across Fleet Intelligence and adjacent teams. **Your Experience** ------------------- * 5\+ years of experience in applied data science, machine learning, statistical modeling, or a closely related role. * A track record of developing and shipping models or decision\-support systems that influenced real customer or business outcomes. * Strong proficiency with Python and SQL, including exploratory analysis, feature engineering, model development, and evaluation on large datasets. * Strong grounding in statistics and machine learning fundamentals, including model selection, validation, calibration, uncertainty, bias, and error analysis. * Experience with time\-series forecasting, regression, classification, ranking, anomaly detection, survival or reliability analysis, or optimization; depth in several of these areas is more important than breadth across all of them. * Experience taking models beyond notebooks into reliable production workflows, including versioning, testing, deployment, observability, performance monitoring, and retraining or refresh strategies. * Experience using modern cloud data platforms and transformation workflows such as Snowflake, dbt, and orchestration tools in support of applied modeling work. * Ability to identify data\-quality limitations, recommend improvements, and collaborate with data engineers on pipelines and source reliability. * Excellent written and verbal communication, particularly when explaining complex methods, uncertainty, and tradeoffs to non\-specialists. * Experience working cross\-functionally with Product, Design, Software Engineering, and Data Engineering. **Considered a Plus** --------------------- * Experience with fleet, transportation, maintenance, reliability, asset management, insurance, logistics, or another operational domain. * Experience modeling maintenance cost, equipment failure, remaining useful life, warranty exposure, utilization, demand, or asset replacement decisions. * Familiarity with semantic layers and analytics tools such as ThoughtSpot or Cube. * Experience designing experiments or evaluating recommendations when randomized testing is impractical. * Experience contributing to customer\-facing software products or collaborating closely with full\-stack product engineers. * Graduate study in statistics, data science, computer science, operations research, applied mathematics, economics, or a related quantitative field. ### **Benefits** * Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family) * Vision insurance * Incentive stock options * 401(k) match of 4% * PTO \- 4 weeks (increases at year two!) * 12 company holidays \+ 2 floating holidays * Parental leave \- birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non\-birthing (4 weeks paid) * FSA \& HSA options * Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid) * Community service funds * Professional development funds * Wellbeing fund \- $150 quarterly * Business expense stipend \- $125 quarterly * Mac laptop \+ new hire equipment stipend * Fully stocked kitchen with tons of drinks \& snacks (BHM only) * Remote working friendly since 2012 \#LI\-Remote *Fleetio provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need.* *This application is not intended to and does not create a contract or offer of employment. Employment with Fleetio is at will.* *If you have a disability or a special need that requires an accommodation , please let us know by calling (205\) 718\-7500\.*

jobs.title: Senior IT & Corporate Engineering
jobs.description: Flex is building the **AI\-native private bank for business owners**. We’re re\-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. **Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.** Since launching publicly in **September 2023**, Flex has scaled from **zero to nine\-figure annualized revenue**, with a clear path to **profitability by late 2026**. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership. Our customers are **affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)**—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a **\~$1T\+ revenue market** hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a **$100B\+ company** by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved. Flex has raised $100M\+ in equity and $300M\+ in debt.* **Mission\-critical problems**: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale. * **High bar, low ego**: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership. * **Speed over comfort**: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results. * **Enduring impact**: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses. **Team \& Locations** We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote. **Flex Fuels Ambition.** ### **About The Role** This role owns IT and corporate engineering at Flex, end to end. It reports directly to the CTO. We think IT's job is enablement. The measure of this function is not how many tickets it closes or how many controls it can point at. It is whether everyone else at Flex can do their work faster and more safely than they could last quarter. A new hire productive on day one instead of day four. An engineer who gets exactly the access they need in minutes, without asking twice and without being handed the keys to everything. A team that can adopt a new tool because someone reviewed it properly, not because they routed around IT to buy it on a personal card. So we are not looking for a gatekeeper, or for someone whose default answer is no. The right person makes the safe path the easy path, and removes friction permanently instead of absorbing it repeatedly. Which is why this role also owns Flex's corporate security posture. Identity, access, endpoints, and the SaaS estate are one system, and the person who makes access fast should be the person who decides how much access is reasonable. Split those across two teams and employees route around both. You'll set conditional access and MFA policy, own privileged access and endpoint posture, and run third\-party OAuth and Workspace grant review. Our security engineers own the product and infrastructure side, the money paths and the code, and you'll work with them constantly. Corporate security is yours to decide, not to implement on someone else's behalf. This is the hard part of the job, and we'd rather say so than leave it as a bonus line. The argument between moving fast and holding a line is now an argument you have with yourself. Day to day, what gets tightened, what gets mitigated, and what we knowingly accept is your call; the large ones come to the CTO, and we'd rather see a close call early than find out you decided it quietly. What we'd ask is that a no comes from a real read of the risk and the business context rather than a standard applied by default. The rest of the work has two halves. The IT half is the fleet, identity, access, the SaaS estate, and the joiner/mover/leaver process, delivered with help from a managed IT partner who handles procurement, device logistics, tier\-1 support, and international coverage. You own that relationship, define the SLA, and enforce it. The corporate engineering half is the part we think makes this a good job: writing the automation and internal tooling that means the IT half doesn't scale linearly with headcount. If a process only works because a person runs it by hand every Tuesday, we'd rather you replaced it. You'd be inheriting an estate here, not starting one. The first year is as much untangling what has already accumulated \- stale access, tools nobody reviewed, processes that work because someone remembers them \- as it is building what comes next. Automate that assessment. Nobody should be reading through a SaaS estate by hand in 2026\. Now the shape of this. Flex is around 150 people, and you would be the only person in this function, with vendor capacity underneath you and a direct line to the CTO. That means real autonomy and real scope from week one. It also means this bing it. * You know you can't be in the loop on every request, and you don't want to be. You build the self\-service paths that let people get what they need without going through you. * You can hold a vendor accountable without turning the relationship adversarial. * You can tell a colleague, including a senior one, that what they've built can't keep the access it has, explain why in plain language, and work alongside them to find a way that works. * You're calm when something is broken and several people are watching. * You explain technical constraints clearly to people who don't share your background, in writing, across time zones. ### **What We're Looking For** * Substantial hands\-on experience owning IT or corporate engineering at a growing company, including a stretch where you were the most senior person doing the work. Roughly \[6\+] years is typical, but we care about what you've owned, not the year count. * Deep, hands\-on ownership of an identity provider (Okta, Entra, JumpCloud, or similar) at the design layer: SSO, SCIM, SAML, group and entitlement modeling. Not just the admin console. * Practical experience running Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 as a platform. * Real MDM and endpoint experience across macOS, and ideally Windows, in a remote or hybrid company. * Automation ability in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, Go, TypeScript, or similar), and comfort with APIs and identity plumbing. * Experience designing an access model and running access reviews, not only fulfilling requests. * Real ownership of identity security decisions, not only their execution. You've set MFA or conditional access policy, tightened privileged access, or cleaned up third\-party app grants, and you can talk about what you traded away to do it. * Track record managing an outsourced IT provider or MSP, or a clear\-eyed view of why the ones you've worked with succeeded or failed. * Clear written communication. jobs.title: Sr Director/VP of Product
jobs.description: **About Flux Power** Flux Power Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: FLUX) is an energy storage company headquartered in Vista, California. Founded in 2009 with a focus on designing and manufacturing lithium battery packs, Flux Power serves customers across material handling, industrial, and commercial markets. With 30,000\+ battery packs deployed across North America and a track record of saving more than 10,000 gallons of CO₂ emissions, the company is in the fourth inning of a significant operational and leadership transformation under a new CEO. This is a company in active growth mode. The leadership team is being strengthened with the right people who can get results, roll up their sleeves, and grow into executive roles as the company scales. This isn’t a bureaucratic environment — it’s a canvas for someone who’s been ready to own a function and prove what they can do. **The Opportunity** Flux Power is creating a new Director / Senior Director of Product role as part of its next phase of growth. This person will own the company’s product support, product quality, and product management functions, reporting directly to the CEO. This is a build role requiring a true product leader — someone with active, recent product management ownership who is customer\-obsessed, deeply commercial, and ready to be the face of Flux Power in strategic customer meetings. Title is open — Director through VP — based on experience and fit. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * **Product strategy:** Define and own the company’s product strategy — not just execution of a roadmap someone else sets. Answer the harder questions: which products and segments deserve investment, where should Flux Power play versus not play, and what does the business case look like behind each major bet (e.g., modularity, new platform decisions). This is a strategic ownership role, not a project management role * **Voice of Customer:** Coordinate with Marketing and Sales to establish a robust VoC program, ensuring customer input is captured and considered throughout the product development process * **Market research:** Analyze customer needs, market trends, and competitive landscape to inform new product development priorities * **Product roadmap:** Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define, manage, and communicate product roadmaps, requirements, and specifications — tracking progress via regular business reviews and structured updates * **Go\-to\-market collaboration:** Partner with Marketing to develop compelling messaging and positioning for new products and solutions * **Engineering handoff:** Deliver clear product specifications and procedures to the engineering team and present commercialization updates to Sales * **Performance and feedback:** Monitor product performance metrics and gather customer feedback to drive continuous improvement across the product line * **Cross\-functional leadership:** Lead cross\-functional teams through the full product development lifecycle, from concept through launch * **Team assessment:** Upon arrival, assess the team you inherit — determine what’s working, identify gaps, and build a plan to optimize the function. This includes making structural decisions and developing the people you inherit * **Quality ownership:** Own product quality outcomes end\-to\-end, including QA processes, ISO certification, and documentation control. Work closely with Engineering so quality feedback from the field continuously informs new product development, rather than being treated as a downstream checkpoint * **Innovation \& expansion opportunities:** Evaluate next\-generation technology and adjacent market opportunities (e.g., new battery chemistries, AI\-driven product features, adjacent verticals such as AMR/AGV) and bring a point of view on where Flux Power should be exploring expansion versus staying focused * **Market \& competitive intelligence:** Build and maintain relationships across the industry to track competitor moves, emerging technologies, and market shifts. Bring forward\-looking intelligence into product and roadmap decisions — this requires being genuinely plugged into the industry through trade shows, networks, and direct relationships, not just secondary research * **Support monetization:** Evaluate the opportunity to package support and service into tiered offerings as a revenue driver rather than a pure cost center — a significant near\-term opportunity given current investment in white\-glove support that is not currently monetized **Must Haves** * Active, recent product management experience — a product management title or clear product ownership within the last 3 years is required. Product management done 10\-15 years ago followed by marketing, engineering, or other roles does not qualify. This is non\-negotiable. * Strong executive presence and customer\-facing communication skills — this person will represent Flux Power in strategic meetings with prospects and customers. If the team cannot picture you presenting to a stranger in two months, you are not the right fit * Strong working knowledge of quality systems, ISO processes, or product lifecycle management * Ability to operate as a player\-coach — you set the strategy and you do the work * Visible roadmap ownership — your profile and experience should clearly show you have defined, prioritized, and communicated a product roadmap. Generic product titles without roadmap accountability are not sufficient * Demonstrated product strategy experience — not just roadmap execution. You should be able to speak to decisions you’ve made about where a company should invest, expand, or pull back, and the business case behind those calls * Excellent communication skills — you will interface with engineering, sales, and the CEO regularly * Demonstrated competitive analysis and market research — your experience should include tracking competitor products, synthesizing customer and market data, and translating that intelligence into product decisions * Managerial courage — comfortable saying no, pushing back on senior stakeholders, and prioritizing with discipline in a resource\-constrained environment. This role carries significant responsibility with limited formal authority and depends on earned trust and influence, not positional power **Strong Preference** * Hardware product background required — batteries, energy storage, automotive, aerospace, chips/semiconductors, networking hardware, or similar physical products. San Diego’s chip and defense hardware ecosystem is a strong source of adjacent candidates. Software or SaaS product backgrounds will not be considered regardless of other qualifications * Experience at a company that has gone through a growth phase or turnaround * Exposure to customer\-facing support operations at scale * Familiarity with product management frameworks (road mapping, voice of customer, requirements definition) **Nice to Have** * Industrial engineering background or technical degree — industrial engineers have historically excelled in similar roles * Experience in a NASDAQ\-listed or public company environment * Direct experience in batteries, forklifts, or material handling equipment — candidates from adjacent or competitor companies in this space are of particular interest We are committed to a safe, drug\-free workplace by performing pre\-employment background checks and substance testing. **Notes** * No recruiters, contractors, or consultants, please. * No visa sponsorships available for this position. **Please review our career page at** https://www.fluxpower.com/careers *\*\*\*Flux Power is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age or disability, or any other class protected by Federal, State or local laws. Flux Power complies with all employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and all must have the authorization to work in the US.* Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $200,000\.00 \- $260,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Relocation assistance * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT GREENBOARD** At Greenboard, we're building the future of financial compliance. Greenboard is the unified, AI\-native compliance operating system for RIAs, fintechs, private funds, hedge funds, and more. It replaces the fragmented mix of legacy tools and automates more than previously possible. By centralizing data and workflows, Greenboard helps firms reduce regulatory risk, simplify their technology stack, modernize how they run compliance, and save money. Our founding team includes engineers who have scaled products at Amazon, Google, and multiple unicorn startups. We're backed by Y Combinator, General Catalyst, Base10, and other top\-tier investors, and have raised over $20M to date. Brand\-name financial institutions already rely on Greenboard, and we're growing fast. **ABOUT THE ROLE** You'll be our first dedicated Automation engineer. Our customers are regulated financial institutions, which means a missed bug is not just a bad user experience. It can mean an incomplete books\-and\-records archive, a marketing review that never routed for approval, or an attestation that quietly failed to send. Quality is part of the product we sell. You'll own how we test: the framework, the automated suites, and the release process, built from scratch and then embedded with the engineers who ship. You'll also help us solve something most automation engineers have never had to solve, which is how to test AI systems whose output is not deterministic. There is no existing playbook here. If you like defining the standard rather than enforcing someone else's, this is the seat. **WHAT YOU'LL OWN** * **The foundation.** Test framework, automated regression suites, and QA practices built from zero, with your call on tooling * **The critical paths.** Message archiving and supervision, marketing review routing, employee attestations, and audit trails, which are the flows that cannot break * **Testing the AI.** How we evaluate AI\-driven detection and review, including golden datasets and quality bars for output that is not deterministic * **Data integrity at scale.** End\-to\-end validation from ingestion of tens of millions of messages a day through to what a compliance officer sees on screen * **The release gate.** Bug triage, release sign\-off, and the definition of deployment\-ready at Greenboard **WHO ARE YOU?** * Love to move fast and build things * Looking for deep ownership over the quality of everything we ship * Obsess over the customers you're building for * An excellent communicator * Value collaboration * Located in NYC **QUALIFICATIONS** * 3\+ years testing software where being wrong has consequences beyond a bad review: fintech, healthtech, payments, or anywhere an audit followed a bug * Able to test a system you cannot fully see from the UI. Comfortable with REST APIs and querying the database directly, because verifying a feature here means checking what landed and what the retention policy did with it, not just what rendered * Write Playwright or Cypress suites that survive a redesign, with opinions about selectors, fixtures, and what belongs in an integration test versus an end\-to\-end one * Can read a feature spec and name the states nobody thought about: the employee who left mid\-attestation, the message that arrives out of order, the marketing piece edited after approval * Have held a release before, explained why to someone who wanted it out, and been right **NICE TO HAVE** * Tested a system where output is not deterministic and had to define correct as a threshold rather than an exact match * Worked in a Node JS and React codebase on AWS, or debugged a queue\-based ingestion pipeline * Been through a SOC 2 audit and know what evidence a test suite can produce for one * Sat with a compliance officer, an advisor, or a back\-office team and watched them work * Interest in the financial industry is a plus, but not necessary **BENEFITS** * 401(k) with 5% company match * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * 15 days PTO \+ 11 company holidays \+ flexible sick time * 2 additional PTO days for each year of service (up to 10 additional days) * 10 remote days per year plus additional around the holidays * Bi\-annual off\-sites and team retreats * Front\-row seat to building the operating backbone of modern finance Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Data & Analytics
jobs.description: **About Us** Greenbrook Medical is building the new standard in primary care. We deliver high\-touch, relationship\-based care through neighborhood clinics, grounded in a simple belief: every senior deserves the kind of care we would want for our own families. Our model prioritizes time with patients, strong care coordination, and a personalized approach that improves outcomes while lowering total cost of care. We take full accountability for patient outcomes and overall cost of care, aligning clinical excellence with disciplined execution. That commitment shows up in our results, including a patient Net Promoter Score of 90, compared to 32 for typical healthcare organizations. Rooted in Tampa Bay and partnered with Tampa General Hospital, we are entering an exciting phase of growth. Backed by strong unit economics, experienced operators, and a proven playbook, we are looking for builders and operators who want to help scale a healthcare platform designed to deliver better care, better coordination, and better outcomes for seniors. **About The Role** We're hiring our first dedicated data person. This person will build on our existing data platform, harden it to ensure consistent performance and build upon our metric library to ensure that our operators can monitor performance across all of our levers. Success in this role means end to end ownership, from data platform to metric delivery and visualization in dashboarding tools As Data and Analytics Engineer, you own four things: * **The analytics layer**: the dbt models and business logic that turn raw data into something usable, and the metric definitions underneath them * **Reporting and BI**: the reporting layer the whole business reads from * **Our production systems**: you take ownership of systems as they come in\-house from our engineering partner, harden them, and keep making them better, with accountability for uptime \& system integrity * **The partnership with our engineering team**: you are the internal counterpart who knows both the business and the systems well enough to resolve most issues directly This is a build\-and\-own role. Our engineering partner stands up a new capability; you take it on once it is live, harden it, and keep improving it. You work as their peer rather than their coordinator. You also partner closely with the pop health team (who owns our value drivers) in defining metrics and deciding together what the business needs to see. You report to the VP of Growth and Population Health. **Location:** New York City strongly preferred (Hybrid). Open to exceptional remote candidates. **What You'll Do** Own the Analytics Layer * Build and maintain the dbt models and business logic our metrics and workflows depend on. Work within Google Cloud to iterate on our business logic and transformation infrastructure * Ensure consistency in definitions across all surfaces at Greenbrook * Work with the performance managers on what needs measuring and what good looks like in their areas Take Ownership of What's in Production * Take on systems as they move from our engineering partner into steady state, and keep them healthy * Be accountable for uptime \& system integrity – catch ingestion and pipeline issues or logic bugs and resolve them within our SLAs. Develop monitoring and uptime reporting. * Ensure a performant system. Optimize workloads and runtime * Keep improving what you take on rather than only maintaining it Partner Across the Business * Be the counterpart our engineering partner can hand production work to, resolving what you can and escalating what needs them * Build dashboards to support organizational decisionmaking * Work closely with the business – sit in the operating meetings where the data gets used, so you know what decisions it feeds **What Success Looks Like** * Data Trust: the business trusts the numbers, and you are ahead of issues rather than behind them * Reliability: systems transitioned to you stay healthy, and when they break they get fixed quickly * Coverage: the metrics our drivers depend on have a certified definition and a single source of truth * Delivery: the work you committed to for the quarter shipped * Metrics you'll own: delivery against committed quarterly work, and counterpart satisfaction among the performance managers and the Head of Population Health **About You** You bring: * Fluency in dbt and Python * Hands on experience with Health care datasets and interoperability frameworks which our business run on, including a deep understanding of claims, eligibility, EHR data, and frameworks such as FHIR and HL7 * A solid grasp of business fundamentals, enough to partner with business and clinical managers on defining metrics rather than only building to spec * Experience owning production systems, including being the person who responds when something breaks * Bachelor's degree required * A mindset grounded in our core values of Heart, Excellence, Accountability, Resilience, and Teamwork You'll stand out if you: * **Want to own a system deeply**: you would rather take something into production, harden it, and keep improving it than move on to the next greenfield build * **Get to root cause**: you find out why a number is wrong rather than patching the symptom * **Are AI\-native**: you live in modern AI tools to support your work * **Communicate with clarity**: you are comfortable explaining complex data to business users and communicate proactively * **Own the outcome**: high bias for action, follow through on commitments, and close loops without needing to be chased **Why You'll Love Working Here** **Make An Impact Every Day** Be part of a mission\-driven team transforming primary care for seniors. Your work directly supports better outcomes, better coordination, and better experiences for some of the most vulnerable patients in healthcare. **Work That Actually Matters** We're not a volume\-driven system, we're accountable for outcomes. That means your work directly contributes to quality care, patient satisfaction, and meaningful improvements in how healthcare is delivered. **Build And Grow With Us** We're building more than a company, we're building careers. As we expand, you'll have opportunities to grow your skills and take on new challenges. **Strong, Transparent Compensation \& Benefits** * $170,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications * Generous annual performance bonus * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Paid time off * 401(k) with company match **Our Selection Process** Application Initial interview Skills/experience interview Values interview Case Study and Case Study Interview References **Equal Employment Opportunity and Commitment to Diversity** At Greenbrook Medical, we believe the only way we accomplish our mission is by building the best team in healthcare. We do this through a culture of respect and belonging, ensuring our teammates feel cared for first and foremost. We will extend equal employment opportunity to all applicants without regard to age, race, ethnicity, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, socioeconomic background, disability status, military affiliation, pregnancy or any other status protected under federal, state and local laws. We encourage all who share our mission to apply. Greenbrook Medical will provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process. If you need additional accommodations or assistance, do not hesitate to contact our People team at recruiting@greenbrookmedical.com.

PowerShell, Bash, or Python * Reduce manual configuration through repeatable provisioning workflows * Improve deployment speed, accuracy, and scalability ### **Hardware Validation** * Perform burn\-in testing and validation of new hardware platforms * Verify compatibility with Grubbrr software and device management systems * Troubleshoot hardware/software integration issues ### **Documentation \& after\-hours troubleshooting when required **Technical Toolkit** --------------------- **Category** **Preferred Skills \& Tools** **Operating Systems** Windows IoT/Pro, Android (Linux experience a plus) **Imaging Tools** Clonezilla, Acronis, Macrium, SCCM, MDT **Remote Access** TeamViewer, LogMeIn, VNC, SSH, VPN tunneling **Device Management** Microsoft Intune, Esper, Hexnode, or similar **Networking** DHCP, static IP configuration, firewalls, DNS fundamentals **Hardware** NUCs, industrial PCs, touch displays, POS printers, scanners, payment devices **Who You Are** --------------- * **Automation\-First Thinker** — If you do something twice, you automate it. * **Detail\-Driven Operator** — You understand that one incorrect configuration can mean a costly field visit. * **Systems Problem Solver** — You enjoy making hardware and software ecosystems work seamlessly together. * **Ownership Mentality** — You take pride in building reliable systems that scale. **Experience \& Qualifications** -------------------------------- * Mid\-level experience supporting hardware systems, device imaging, or endpoint management * Experience with system provisioning, scripting, or automation strongly preferred * Comfortable working in a fast\-paced engineering environment * Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills * Ability to work onsite in Boca Raton, FL **Growth Opportunity** ---------------------- This role is designed for candidates interested in expanding toward: * DevOps Engineering. Systems Engineering, Infrastructure Automation and/or * Device Fleet Management at scale You will work closely with software engineers and product teams while gaining hands\-on experience with deployment automation and infrastructure operations. **Work Environment** -------------------- * On\-site collaboration required (5 days/week) * Occasional but rare travel for hardware validation * Some after\-hours support responsibilities as needed **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- * Salary: **$50,000 – $60,000,** Full\-time W\-2 employment * Health (Medical/Dental). 401k and PTO benefits * Discretionary bonus eligibility **Work Authorization** ---------------------- Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Grubbrr welcomes applicants with valid work authorization, including eligible visa holders, in compliance with U.S. employment laws. jQuhqUOS8F

managing source code. * AgileSDLC: 2\+ years of experience working within an Agile software development environment, participating in sprint rituals (standups, planning, retrospectives) and translating user stories into technical specifications. * Data Formats: Proficient with standard web data interchange and integration formats, including JSON and XML. * Web Hosting: Experience working with Microsoft Internet Information Services (IIS v10\) and Windows Server (2016, 2019, 2022\) operating environments. * Analytical Capabilities: Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and debugging capabilities to isolate and resolve complex software defects and system performance bottlenecks. * Communication Skills: Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to jobs.title: Web Developer
jobs.description: **Love building new things—but also get a weird amount of satisfaction from tracking down the one plugin, line of code or integration causing everything to misbehave? Hiebing is looking for a curious and resourceful Web Developer who’s excited to build smart digital experiences, solve unfamiliar problems and keep growing alongside a collaborative team. WordPress will be at the center of the role, but your work—and your opportunity to make an impact—will extend well beyond it.** Hiebing is seeking a curious, motivated and innovative Web Developer who is eager to build intelligent solutions in a fast\-paced, collaborative team environment. Our team values learning, support and innovation, creating a culture where developers can grow, contribute and have fun doing great work. WordPress development and maintenance will be at the center of this role, but we’re looking for someone who is equally energized by troubleshooting an integration, helping implement tagging, debugging an email or figuring out something they haven’t encountered before. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter who is curious, resourceful and motivated to find answers independently. They see unfamiliar challenges as opportunities to learn rather than barriers and are comfortable moving between different types of digital work as client and team needs evolve. This role will initially be divided between new WordPress development and maintenance for existing clients, with the potential to create new capabilities and offerings for our clients and eventually lead the WordPress development practice at Hiebing. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Develop, enhance and maintain WordPress websites, including block editor/Gutenberg development, theme customization, plugin configuration and integrations. * Troubleshoot and resolve website issues, including plugin conflicts, third\-party integrations, browser and device inconsistencies, and performance problems. * Support ongoing website maintenance, landing pages, forms, content migrations and other digital enhancements across multiple client properties. * Assist with analytics and tagging implementations using tools such as Google Tag Manager and GA4, including implementation, troubleshooting and QA. * Support email development and production needs, including building and modifying HTML emails, troubleshooting rendering or template issues, and conducting technical QA. * Implement and troubleshoot marketing technology integrations, including forms, analytics, consent management, email platforms and other third\-party tools. * Work within Git\-based development workflows and follow established practices for commits, branching, pull requests, releases and documentation. * Collaborate with developers, digital strategists, project managers, designers and other team members to solve problems and deliver high\-quality work. * Maintain security, accessibility, performance and quality standards across development work. **Required Skills and Experience** ---------------------------------- * 2–3 years of professional web development experience, with meaningful hands\-on WordPress theme development experience. * Comfort using GitHub Copilot for AI\-assisted development and as part of the problem\-solving process. * Strong HTML, CSS and JavaScript fundamentals. * Working knowledge of PHP and WordPress development. * Experience with WordPress themes, plugins, Gutenberg/block editor and common marketing\-site integrations. * Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills. * Experience working with Git\-based version control. * Ability and willingness to work across different types of technical assignments rather than specializing exclusively in one area. * Resourceful and comfortable researching unfamiliar problems and identifying solutions independently. * Self\-motivated, with the ability to take ownership of work and follow it through to completion. * Curious and eager to learn new technologies, platforms and approaches. * Familiarity with analytics, tagging and marketing integrations, including GA4/GTM, consent tools, A/B testing, email providers and CDPs. * Accessibility awareness, including WCAG fundamentals, and experience implementing accessible UI patterns. * Able to manage multiple priorities and shift between projects in a fast\-paced environment. * Collaborative, dependable and committed to producing high\-quality work. **Nice\-to\-Have Skills and Qualifications** -------------------------------------------- * WooCommerce or Shopify experience, including checkout optimization, payment and shipping plugins, and catalog organization. * Comfort with WP\-CLI, Composer, deployment automation and modern WordPress build pipelines. * Experience implementing WordPress hardening practices, including secure configuration, plugin governance and least\-privilege access. * Familiarity with unit testing or automated regression testing. * Hands\-on experience with Email on Acid or Litmus to create visual and brand consistency across email devices and clients. **You’ll Thrive Here If…** -------------------------- * You enjoy building new digital experiences—and making existing ones work better. * You see an unfamiliar technical problem as something to
