jobs.title: Senior System Administrator
jobs.description: **About Radiant** ----------------- Radiant is an El Segundo, CA\-based startup building the world’s first mass\-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The company’s first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1\-megawatt, fail\-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is needed and run for up to 5 years without refueling. Portable nuclear power with rapid\-deploy capability can replace similar\-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases. Radiant’s unique, practical approach to nuclear development leverages modern software engineering to rapidly deliver safe, factory\-built microreactors that use existing, well\-qualified materials. Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028\. **About the Role:** ------------------- Radiant is seeking a Senior Systems Administrator to own the systems that keep the company running day\-to\-day within Microsoft 365 GCC High. You'll own the tenant, build our identity and access automation from the ground up in an Entra\-native environment with no on\-prem Active Directory or Group Policy, and manage the endpoint, email security, and SaaS infrastructure the business runs on. You'll implement and evidence the technical controls behind our CMMC assessment as part of the normal job, not a detour. This is a high\-ownership seat in an interdisciplinary environment, advancing milestones toward commercializing the first mass\-produced nuclear reactor. **Responsibilities and Duties:** -------------------------------- * Own Microsoft 365 GCC High: Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and the tenant configuration underneath them; be the authority on what's possible in this cloud and what has to be built in\-house * Own Entra end\-to\-end: conditional access, privileged access, app registrations, and single sign\-on * Build the IAM automation layer, the centerpiece of the role: joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle, entitlements driven by HR data, provisioning through Graph and SCIM, and access reviews that run themselves * Own Windows and endpoint management through Intune, Autopilot, compliance policy, and update rings across the fleet, with no Group Policy underneath * Own email security and information protection: Defender for Office, mail flow and anti\-phishing posture, and Purview for DLP, labeling, and retention in an environment handling CUI * Own SaaS administration and integration across the business application portfolio, including Box and Slack; some running today, some a project waiting for an owner * Own the workloads, services, and licensing infrastructure running in AWS, in constant contact with the IT DevOps engineer who owns the account layer * Take new platform projects from idea to deployed, integrated, and documented * Implement and evidence the technical controls in these areas for the CMMC assessment ahead, as normal work rather than a detour **Required Qualifications and Skills:** --------------------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a similar field (4 years of work experience in lieu of a degree) * 7\+ years administering and engineering production systems * Deep, hands\-on experience across the responsibilities above: GCC High tenant administration, Entra, self\-built IAM automation, Intune without Group Policy, email security and Purview, and SaaS/AWS administration * Solid networking fundamentals: VLANs, routing, firewall policy, DNS/DHCP, VPN, wireless * Treats compliance control implementation and evidence collection as normal work * Service is the job; tier\-1 handles day\-to\-day support, but nobody's too senior to help the person at their desk **Desired Qualifications and Skills:** -------------------------------------- * Purview depth: DLP, sensitivity labeling, retention, or eDiscovery * CMMC or NIST 800\-171 exposure; leading an assessment is not required * Stood up identity governance tooling: Entra ID Governance, SailPoint, Okta Workflows, or equivalent * Automation experience with PowerShell, Python, Microsoft Graph, and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Bicep, or similar) * Written and maintained PowerShell modules other people use, not just scripts * Deployed Box, Slack, or comparable platforms into a regulated environment and handled the data boundary questions **Additional Requirements** --------------------------- * Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as necessary to accomplish our mission. * Must work 100% onsite at El Segundo HQ. **Benefits and Perks** ---------------------- * Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full\-time employees. * Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee \+ 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans. * One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents. * Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage \+ 50% for dependents. * Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents. * Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits. * 8\-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees. * Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks. * Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation. * Company and team\-bonding events, happy hours and in\-person camaraderie. * Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean. **Total Compensation and Benefits** Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar. Radiant’s new hire compensation package includes base salary, substantial equity grants, and comprehensive health benefits. Total compensation and level are determined through a rigorous evaluation of interview performance, experience, education, and qualifications, and are designed to support continued growth as scope, responsibility, and impact expand at Radiant. The best of today’s advanced reactor builders don’t wait for job postings. They join the winning team. If that’s you, contact us directly for immediate opportunities: recruiting@radiantnuclear.com. *We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.* *This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.* Compensation Range: $133,500 \- $190,050

jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary Red Hat Global Engineering is looking for an Associate Software Engineer who is intrigued by how things work and constantly looks for ways to make them better. In this role, you will not just be a tester, you will also be a developer who designs, automates, and finds creative ways to solve potential problems. You'll be required to interpret test requirements from customer use cases and develop innovative automated solutions for the testing of real\-world customer workflows in test environments. Primary Job Responsibilities * Design, develop, and maintain test environments and automated test suites * Develop test cases in Python and maintain a thorough understanding of the functionality of our offerings * Ensure continued quality of existing features and assess the quality of newly developed and planned features a products strategic direction * Contribute to our test automation framework * Contribute to test tooling projects related to deploying test environments and infrastructure, automating test pipelines, reporting test results, etc. * Deliver clear status for testing areas in a timely manner * Explore, Identify and document new bugs clearly and accurately * Work in a fast\-paced agile environment * Work with other teams internally Required Skills * Python experience * Experience with Linux or UNIX systems * Experience with Git or other source control technologies * Interest in testing and investigating how things work internally * Ability to coordinate and help others solve difficult problems * Good written and verbal communication skills in English * Ability to work on a fast\-paced project The following is considered a plus: * Understanding of container technologies like Docker or Kubernetes, any cloud (Aws/Azure/GCE) knowledge. * Configuration management, e.g., Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, Chef, or Puppet, experience * Experience with continuous integration (CI) or CD tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Travis and creating test pipelines * Experience using or participating in open source projects Red Hat will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position. Actual offer will be based on your qualifications.**Pay Transparency** Red Hat determines compensation based on several factors including but not limited to job location, experience, applicable skills and training, external market value, and internal pay equity. For positions with Remote\-US locations, the actual salary range for the position may differ based on location but will be commensurate with job duties and relevant work experience. **About Red Hat** Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community\-powered approach to deliver high\-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Operations
jobs.description: At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known. Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us. **About the Team:** The Interplanetary Sciences Program was established to expand access to scientific exploration across our solar system. Its mission is to make planetary research faster, more affordable, and more capable than ever before by rethinking how science missions are designed, built, and operated. The program aims to enable scientists to send instruments to distant worlds without decades of development or prohibitive costs. By creating a sustainable model for interplanetary exploration, we are transforming space science from an occasional event into a continuous process of discovery that accelerates knowledge, broadens participation, and inspires the next generation of explorers. **About the Role:** The Interplanetary Sciences Program is building the operations software that will optimize the mission science and innovate in how we operate the spacecraft. The software will command, monitor, and coordinate the spacecraft, its science instruments, and its communications systems across the Mars 2028 mission. At Relativity Space, we set audacious goals. The Mars 2028 mission is designed to transform how we conduct interplanetary science missions bringing AI models to run on the spacecraft in Mars orbit. The instrument suite will sense the atmosphere to inform weather models and probe the surface with Radar to understand the location of ice. The mission operations for the Mars 2028 mission will also be ground\-breaking with automation across the whole stack to enable autonomous science collection meaning the spacecraft can be re\-tasked to acquire follow\-up observations based on analysis and inference of recent data on the flight hardware. As a Software Engineer – Operations, you will design and build the tools that mission operators, instrument teams, and external partners rely on every day from command generation and validation, to telemetry and data dissemination, to the interfaces that let outside teams safely and reliably interact with our systems. This is a high ownership and hands\-on engineering role at the intersection of software, spacecraft operations, and cross\-team collaboration, with real influence over how the mission is run. Operations software is the layer between a spacecraft hundreds of millions of kilometers away and the humans, instruments, and partner organizations that depend on it working correctly, every time. The tools you build will directly shape how safely and efficiently this mission commands its spacecraft, ingests its science data, and supports the instrument teams counting on us to get it right. **What You'll Do:** * **Design and implement operations software:** Build, test, and operate spacecraft commanding tools — including command generation, validation, sequencing, and constraint\-checking software — using modern engineering practices and AI\-assisted / agentic development tools to accelerate implementation without compromising rigor. * **Work cross\-functionally:** partner with mission operations, GN\&C, flight software, instrument, and ground systems teams inside Relativity Space, as well as external partners and instrument providers, to translate operational needs into working software. * **Build test suites:** build automated test suites and validation frameworks covering spacecraft commanding, telemetry processing, and data dissemination — including regression tests, simulation/flatsat\-based validation, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop test support — so that changes to operations software can be verified quickly and safely before they touch the mission. * **Define external interfaces:** define and document the interfaces (ICDs, APIs, data formats) that instrument teams and other external stakeholders use to interact with operations tools, ensuring those interfaces are clear, stable, and well\-supported across the life of the mission. * **Automate tooling** for commanding, telemetry visualization, anomaly investigation, and data pipelines as mission needs change over time. **About You:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * 3\+ years of software engineering experience, ideally including some exposure to mission operations, ground systems, command and control, or other safety\- or mission\-critical software * Strong software fundamentals and hands\-on proficiency with Python or a comparable language * Experience designing and writing automated test suites (unit, integration, and/or regression tests) for complex or safety\-critical systems * Experience defining or working against external\-facing interfaces or APIs (ICDs, schemas, protocol definitions) shared with other teams or organizations * Comfort working cross\-functionally with engineers, operators, and external partners who may have very different technical backgrounds and priorities * Experience with agentic development tools (e.g., AI coding agents/assistants) as part of a professional software engineering workflow, including knowing when and how to verify their output in a mission\-critical context *During critical mission phases including launch, commissioning, cruise* *maneuvers* *and early operations this position will require shift work and on\-call availability. Schedule flexibility will be needed as operational needs evolve. Occasional travel (\<10%) to partner institutions and mission integration sites may be* *required* **We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.** ***If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at*** ***accommodations@relativityspace.com******.*** ***Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission \- via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee \- will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.***

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Data Cloud
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the Data Cloud Team** ----------------------------- Rippling Data Cloud is a new suite of products that aggregates data from across your company into Rippling, connects it to worker identity, and makes it available for analysis, visualization and action. It preserves and enriches data context to enable precise and accurate answers to your most important and nuanced business questions. It's a complete data stack including data connectors, transformations, visualizations, AI\-powered analytics, and even inbound Zero\-Copy. It understands how all of that data relates to employees, managers, departments, locations, cost centers, permissions, and historical changes in your ever\-changing business. That makes it possible to ask questions that traditional BI systems struggle to answer correctly. **Data Cloud as the foundation for Rippling AI** ------------------------------------------------ Data Cloud and AI are deeply connected in Rippling. Data Cloud is the data infrastructure layer that powers Rippling AI. Here's how they relate: **Data Cloud provides the unified data that AI reasons over:** Rippling AI leverages the Employee Graph and all platform data (payroll rules, earnings types, deduction logic, permissions, etc.) as its source of truthBecause Rippling is a unified platform rather than stitched\-together acquisitions, the data is clean, consistent, and complete which makes AI answers accurate and context\-awareAI respects the same permissions model as the rest of the platform, so it only surfaces data the user is authorized to see **The Rippling AI unlocks advanced Data Cloud capabilities:** * AI Dashboards: build dashboards from scratch using natural language prompts * Transformations: full publish access * Pipelines: ingest data via managed connectors * Lineage \& Catalog: explore data lineage for reports * Advanced features: parameters, SQL queries, and the ability to incorporate third\-party data **Why this matters** Most HR/Finance systems weren't built for AI. Their data is messy and fragmented. Rippling AI is described as the first "context\-aware, senior analyst" for HR and Finance teams because it sits on top of a unified data model (Data Cloud \+ Employee Graph) that actually understands your business logic end\-to\-end. **What We Build** ----------------- The team is focused on the following core domains: * **Analytics** – Focuses on the reporting and dashboarding products that enable users to visualize and analyze data within Rippling. * **Data Access** – Owns the query engine (RQL, Rippling Query Language) that powers data retrieval across the platform. This area includes sub\-teams responsible for query execution, data ingestion, and query history. * **Data Management** – Owns the metadata and data catalog layer, including how data assets are discovered, governed, and documented. * **Ingest \& Prep** – Responsible for bringing external data into Rippling. This area includes Managed Connectors (pre\-built integrations with third\-party systems) and Transformations (data shaping and preparation). * **Insights** – A newer area within Data Cloud focused on surfacing actionable insights from data. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Work on distributed processing engines and distributed databases * Develop high\-quality software with attention to detail using tech stacks like Python, MongoDB, CDC, and Kafka * Leverage big data technologies like Aurora, Trino, Presto, Pinot, Iceberg, Flink and more. * Build custom programming languages within the Rippling Platform * Create data platforms, data lakes, and data ingestion systems that work at scale * Design, develop, code, and test software systems, improvements, products, and user\-facing experiences * Work alongside software architects and senior developers doing state\-of\-the\-art development work * Contribute to product design and implementation discussions * Find and build unique solutions to implement projects from the idea phase to production **What You'll Need** -------------------- * 6\+ years experience in backend engineering roles * Experience writing testable and performant backend code * Experience working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment * Experience mentoring less\-experienced developers * Ability to thrive in an environment that grants you a lot of autonomy to explore creative solutions **Additional Information** -------------------------- Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below. **The pay range for this role is:** 168,000 \- 280,000 USD per year(US San Francisco Bay Area) 168,000 \- 280,000 USD per year(US Tier 1\)

jobs.title: AI Engineer – Controls & Capability Enablement
jobs.description: About Rockefeller Capital Management: Rockefeller Capital Management was established in 2018 as a leading independent financial advisory services firm. Originally founded in 1882 as the family office of John D. Rockefeller, the Firm has evolved to offer strategic advice to ultra\- and high\-net\-worth individuals and families, institutions, and corporations from offices in 35 markets throughout the United States, as well as an office in London. The Firm oversees $228 billion in client assets as of July 31, 2026\. Position: The primary purpose of this role is to enable the safe, deliberate, and accelerated adoption of AI across Rockefeller Capital Management. Partnering closely with Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity (CISO), and AI Risk Governance teams, the individual translates governance requirements into scalable technical controls that govern the firm's AI ecosystem, including agents, copilots, skills, plugins, connectors, and the large language models that power them. AI platforms evolve rapidly, with new models, capabilities, and features released on a near\-weekly basis. This role is responsible for staying ahead of that pace by continuously evaluating emerging technologies from providers such as Microsoft, Anthropic, and other vendors. The individual will assess new capabilities through both a business value and risk lens, providing clear recommendations on whether they should be adopted, piloted, restricted, or deferred. This is a highly hands\-on technical role focused on operationalizing AI governance. Rather than creating policy, the individual interprets existing requirements and implements them directly through platform configuration, policy enforcement, APIs, automation, and administrative tooling across Microsoft and Anthropic environments. The goal is to ensure AI controls are embedded, measurable, and enforceable while supporting the firm's continued innovation and growth. Responsibilities: * Interpret and implement enterprise control requirements. Translate policies, standards, and risk decisions issued by Risk, Compliance, the CISO organization, and AI Risk Governance into concrete technical controls, review gates, and deployment standards for AI capabilities. * Configure and script the controls. Implement guardrails directly across Microsoft and Anthropic services — tenant and admin center settings, Copilot and Copilot Studio policies, Azure AI Foundry configuration, Anthropic enterprise administration, Entra access policies, and Purview data protection controls. * Automate governance at scale. Build scripts and automation (PowerShell, Graph API, Python, KQL) to inventory agents and skills, enforce policy, detect drift, monitor usage, and produce audit and compliance evidence. * Own agents and skills end to end. Maintain the inventory, ownership model, and lifecycle — from intake and review through deployment, monitoring, recertification, and retirement. * Run capability review assessments. Evaluate new AI features and use cases against firm\-defined risk, security, and compliance criteria — covering business value, security exposure, data access and entitlement impact, supervisory obligations, operational readiness, and fit with enterprise * architecture standards — and escalate to the appropriate governance body where a policy decision is required. * Assess LLMs and model changes. Test and compare models across providers, track model and version updates, evaluate capability shifts and failure modes, and provide the technical evidence governance bodies need to decide where each model may be used. * Stay ahead of AI evolution. Systematically track roadmaps, release notes, and previews across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Anthropic, and emerging platforms, and translate each change into a clear enable, pilot, restrict, or defer recommendation. * Implement controls for safe sharing and reuse. Configure how agents and skills are scoped, shared, and permissioned in line with approved requirements, including departmental boundaries, intent review, and guardrails against unintended data exposure. * Partner across the firm. Work closely with Risk, Compliance, the CISO organization, AI Risk Governance, platform engineering, product, and business teams to confirm intent, close gaps, and ensure capabilities launch with the required controls already in place. * Report clearly to leadership and governance forums. Produce decision records, review summaries, control evidence, and executive\-ready briefings on AI capability posture, risks, and adoption Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field. * 5\+ years in enterprise technology, with at least 2 years working directly with generative AI, LLMs, copilots, or agent platforms. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience configuring tenants, platform, or security controls — not just specifying them. * Proficiency in scripting and automation with  pts, grounding, connectors, and retrieval behave — including where they can leak data or produce unreliable results. * Strong grasp of identity, access, and data protection fundamentals, ideally in an Entra and Purview environment. * Proven ability to read a policy or control standard and determine what it means in practice for a platform configuration. * Clear, concise writing and the confidence to present recommendations to senior stakeholders. Skills: * Familiarity with AI cost and consumption management — token metering, prompt\-caching economics, spending limits, and chargeback or show back models. * Exposure to responsible AI or AI risk frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework or ISO/IEC 42001\. * Familiarity with AI supply\-chain risk — untrusted skills, plugins, and MCP servers as an attack vector — and with registry, scanning, and gating approaches to control them. * Practical experience with model evaluation, benchmarking, red\-teaming, or prompt\-injection and jailbreak testing. * Experience ingesting AI platform telemetry into Microsoft Sentinel or Defender XDR and extending incident\-response playbooks to AI\-specific alerts. * Experience with network\- and proxy\-layer enforcement of AI traffic, including application\-identity or URL\-category policy, TLS inspection, and egress control for cloud\-resident agents that bypass the corporate firewall. * Familiarity with Microsoft Purview DLP, sensitivity labels, Entra External ID, and data entitlement enforcement. * Hands\-on experience deploying client and endpoint policy through Intune or Group Policy — for example, pinning an AI desktop application to the enterprise tenant and forcing SSO. * Familiarity with agent and non\-human identity models, including on\-behalf\-of execution, admin\-assigned agent permissions, and central agent registration in Entra, Agent 365, or Azure AI Foundry. * Experience administering the agent and skill lifecycle in Copilot Studio, Agent 365, or Anthropic enterprise administration — inventory, ownership, sharing controls, and inactivity review. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code or configuration management (Terraform, Bicep, ARM) applied to platform governance. * Experience supporting technology intake, control testing, or audit and evidence process. * Experience in financial services or another regulated industry, including familiarity with supervisory and recordkeeping obligations. * Experience validating audit, e\-discovery, and records\-retention coverage for a new platform, including provider compliance or audit APIs and OpenTelemetry\-based log export. Compensation Range: The anticipated base salary range for this role is $150,000 to $200,000\. Base salary for the role will depend on several factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience, and may fall outside of the range shown. In addition, this role may be eligible for a discretionary bonus. Rockefeller Capital Management offers a comprehensive benefit package including health coverage, vacation time, paid leave, retirement plan, and more. Visit careers.rockco.com to learn more about additional opportunities and benefits offerings. Disclosure: Rockefeller \& Co. jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description: STAR Autism Support has an opening for Quality Assurance Engineer! STAR Autism Support (SAS) is a family\-founded educational consulting company based in Portland, OR. SAS provides curriculum materials, workshops and training to school and agency staff who work with students with autism and other developmental disabilities. Our unique and practical approach provides school districts with curriculum resources and a continuum of professional development activities to address the educational needs of student’s early childhood through post\-secondary throughout the country and internationally. At SAS our goal is to cultivate a supportive, positive and welcoming work environment where all staff can successfully thrive. We value and celebrate equity, diversity, and inclusion. Our vision of equity includes a continuous commitment to becoming an antiracist, multicultural organization. We strive to provide all employees with a culture of curiosity and continued learning. **Position Summary/Objective** Star Autism Support builds curriculum, training, and software for educators teaching students with autism and developmental disabilities. Our software gets used in classrooms by teachers and paraprofessionals who have a few minutes between activities. A confusing screen or a slow data page costs them time with a student. This is our first dedicated QA hire. You will build our automated test coverage from the ground up, run usability and performance testing, and set the quality practices the product development team works to. That means choosing tooling and standards yourself, and working embedded with the team rather than as a gate at the end. **Essential Functions and Responsibilities** Functional testing and automation * Build and own automated regression suites for our web apps and APIs, wired into CI. * Decide what belongs in unit, integration, contract, and end\-to\-end tests, and push coverage to the cheapest layer that catches the problem. * Write test code other engineers can read and extend. Fix or delete flaky tests rather than retrying them. * Run exploratory and risk\-based manual testing where automation is not the right tool. * Own release verification: smoke suites, environment checks, and a clear go/no\-go call. User testing * Plan and run usability testing with educators and internal subject\-matter experts, from task scripts through to findings. * Work with product and design on UAT, including feedback cycles with pilot districts and classrooms. * Own accessibility testing against WCAG 2\.2 AA and Section 508, using automated scanners plus manual screen\-reader and keyboard\-only passes. This matters more here than at most companies. * Turn findings into prioritized issues rather than a list of observations. Performance testing * Build load, stress, soak, and spike tests, with attention to back\-to\-school traffic peaks. * Set performance baselines and SLOs and track them so regressions show up before customers find them. * Help diagnose bottlenecks: slow queries, N\+1 patterns, payload bloat, front\-end render cost. * Report results leadership can act on: response times at percentile, error rates under load, remaining headroom. Best practices and enablement * Document and maintain testing standards, test data strategy, bug reporting conventions, and definition of done. * Coach engineers to test their own work. The goal is a team that ships quality, not a QA bottleneck. * Report quality metrics: escaped defects, coverage of critical paths, suite reliability. * Contribute to release process, code review, and CI/CD design from a quality angle. * Keep FERPA and COPPA considerations in view where they touch test data. **Qualifications** Required * 5\+ years in software quality engineering or QA automation. * Ownership of an automated test suite you built or substantially rebuilt, not just executed. * Proficiency in at least one automation language (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, or C\#). * Experience with a modern end\-to\-end framework such as Playwright or Cypress. * Hands\-on API testing, including auth flows and data setup. * Experience running performance or load tests with a code\-based tool such as Gatling or k6\. * Experience planning and moderating user or usability testing sessions. * Comfort with CI/CD pipelines and Git workflows. * Strong writing. This role produces documentation people have to use. * Ability to set your own priorities without an existing playbook. Preferred * Accessibility testing against WCAG and Section 508, including screen readers. * EdTech, K–12, healthcare, or another domain with real compliance and privacy constraints. * Mobile and tablet testing. Much classroom use is on iPads and Chromebooks. * Visual regression, contract testing, or synthetic monitoring in production. * Cloud infrastructure and containerized test environments. * Mentoring engineers on testing practice, or standing up a QA function previously. * Interest in special education, applied behavior a t * Adaptable and easily able to pivot as needed * Strong organizational skills and attention to detail * Self\-motivated and proficient at working both independently and as part of a team * Intermediate Microsoft office skills and competence in a digital environment * Ability to streamline workflows by leveraging automation and AI tools to enhance efficiency and accuracy Role KSA’s * Advanced knowledge of software quality engineering and test automation. * Skill in building maintainable test suites within CI/CD pipelines. * Knowledge of functional, usability, accessibility, and performance testing. * Ability to assess risk, diagnose issues, and prioritize findings. * Ability to establish scalable quality standards, metrics, and release practices. * Skill in collaborating across technical and nontechnical teams. * Knowledge of privacy and data\-handling requirements in educational technology. * Ability to independently select tools, set priorities, and build QA practices. **Work Environment** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The job is performed in a home office at a workstation with a telephone, headset, and computer. Home offices should be secure, quiet, and distraction\-free as possible. Your work area should be ergonomic, clean, safe, and free of obstructions and hazardous situations. **Physical Demands (Capability Requirements)** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to enter text or data into a computer by means of a keyboard. The employee is required to sit for long periods of time. The employee is required to express or exchange ideas verbally to impart oral information and to convey detailed spoken instructions. Specific vision abilities required by this job include clarity of vision including reading small print and the use of computers. Specific hearing abilities required include the ability to hear, understand, and distinguish speech in person and over the phone. **The perks of working with us** Not only are you helping do good in the world, but you will be joining a team of passionate and exceptional people within a casual environment. We offer a full suite of benefits including: * Retirement plan options with company matching * Generous paid time off, including paid holidays and office closure days * Paid COVID\-19 sick leave * Health Insurance Coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision, and Flexible Spending Accounts) * Life and Disability Insurance options * Employee Assistance Program We are a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. STAR Autism Support (SAS) is committed to the principles of diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI). jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** GibbsCAM is one of the most established CAM platforms in the manufacturing industry, with a history spanning more than 40 years. We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our team of engineers who take genuine pride in craft, reliability, and building software that real machinists depend on every day. This is a strong growth opportunity for an engineer with a solid foundation in C\+\+ and a curiosity about complex, domain\-rich software. You will work alongside experienced senior engineers who are invested in mentorship and knowledge transfer, and you will have the opportunity to take on meaningful, challenging work from day one. The role suits someone who is eager to learn a specialized domain, comfortable reading and reasoning about code they did not write, and excited to grow their skills within a stable, long\-lived product. This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates authorized to work and residing in the United States. **Primary Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain software features for a large\-scale Windows desktop CAM application, working from specifications provided by Product Management and senior engineers. * Diagnose and resolve defects in existing code, with guidance from senior team members on complex issues spanning large or unfamiliar subsystems. * Perform repair, enhancement, and maintenance of software components, writing clean and well\-tested code that meets the team’s quality standards. * Participate actively in code reviews — both as an author and a reviewer — contributing to a culture of shared ownership and continuous improvement. * Learn and apply relevant domain concepts in CAM and manufacturing as needed to contribute effectively to the product. * Maintain currency with modern C\+\+ and software development best practices, applying them appropriately within the constraints of a mature codebase. * Contribute to technical documentation and assist in keeping internal knowledge bases current. * Consult with senior engineers and management on project status, technical questions, and implementation approaches. **Required Qualifications** * 3–5 years of professional software development experience in a production environment. * Solid proficiency in C and C\+\+; exposure to modern standards (C\+\+11/14/17\) preferred. * Experience reading, debugging, and extending existing codebases — not just writing code from scratch. * Familiarity with Windows desktop application development. * Working knowledge of debugging tools and the ability to systematically isolate and resolve software defects. * Understanding of core data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented design principles. * Experience with version control in a team setting. * Solid math fundamentals and willingness to engage with technical or geometric concepts as needed by the domain. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Win32, MFC, COM, or other Windows application frameworks. * Exposure to C\# in a mixed\-language (C\+\+/managed) application context. * Any experience or academic background in CAD, CAM, CNC machining, or manufacturing. * Familiarity with 3D graphics concepts or APIs (OpenGL, DirectX, or similar). * Background or coursework in applied mathematics, linear algebra, or computational geometry. * Experience with Perforce or other enterprise version control systems. * Exposure to large\-project build systems. **Education** * Bachelor’s degree required , with preferred focus in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering. * Equivalent practical experience demonstrating the required technical foundation will be considered. **What to Expect** We understand that a specialized product like GibbsCAM takes time to learn. New team members work with our experienced engineers who provide direction and mentorship during onboarding, and we set realistic expectations for ramp\-up time. We are more interested in hiring someone with strong fundamentals and genuine curiosity than someone who already checks every domain\-specific box. Our team values steady, high\-quality work over heroics. You’ll have the opportunity to grow into greater ownership and technical leadership over time as you build familiarity with the product and codebase. \#LI\-Remote

and integration. * Understanding of database concepts including SQL, data modeling, and data processing. * Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. * Exposure to AI/ML As AI workloads continue to grow, intelligent power distribution, digital power conversion, and real\-time infrastructure monitoring have become critical technologies enabling reliable and efficient operation of modern data centers. As an Electrical \& Embedded Systems Co\-op, you will join a multidisciplinary R\&D team developing intelligent Rack Power Distribution Units (rPDUs), high\-density power shelves, and advanced embedded control systems for AI infrastructure. This role provides hands\-on experience working at the intersection of power electronics, embedded systems and edge AI development. Duration: January 2027\-July 2027 **What will you do?** As a member of our cross functional R\&D team, you will:* Collaborate with electrical, firmware, mechanical, and test engineers to develop intelligent rack PDUs and high\-density power shelves for AI data centers. * Support embedded hardware bring\-up, board debugging, and system integration activities. * Develop and validate embedded software, device drivers, and communication interfaces using C and Python. * Assist in implementing digital control algorithms for advanced power converters and power management systems. * Explore embedded AI applications for predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, and intelligent power monitoring. * Work with communication protocols such as UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, and Ethernet. * Perform laboratory testing, system validation, and performance characterization of hardware and firmware. * Support schematic review, PCB development, technical documentation, and product lifecycle management activities using Cadence and PDM tools. The company does not provide sponsorship now or in the future.*** **Preferred qualifications*** Understanding of power electronics, switched\-mode power supplies and digital power control concepts. * Experience with STM32, TI C2000 embedded MCU platforms. * Exposure to machine learning, edge AI, TinyML, data analytics, or predictive maintenance applications. * Experience with Git, CI/CD workflows, and automated software testing. * Familiarity with schematic capture and PCB development tools such as Cadence. * Experience with AI model deployment on embedded devices is a plus. \#secareers Local Benefits (English): At Schneider Electric, we believe that every employee is a talent who deserves equal opportunities. jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description: Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL) is looking for someone to join our Manufacturing Operations team as a Process Engineer in one of three locations: **Lewiston, ID; Pullman, WA; or West Lafayette, IN**. If you are looking to grow your career and are motivated by solving meaningful problems, we encourage you to apply today! As a Process Engineer, you will identify opportunities to improve manufacturing processes, helping to increase efficiency, quality, and safety across operations. You will work closely with production and other teams to troubleshoot issues, implement process improvements, and support day\-to\-day manufacturing activities. You will also use data and continuous improvement principles to help drive better performance and reliable results. **A typical day as a Process Engineer might include:** * Providing engineering support in multiple areas of manufacturing. * Specifying, developing, justifying, implementing, and sustaining assembly equipment and materials. * Improving quality, yield, efficiency, and capacity of processes in accordance with strategic objectives. * Applying statistical problem solving to identify root causes. * Evaluating new equipment and processes and process improvement activities. * Interpreting results and providing recommendations to management. * Keeping abreast of new developments in equipment, industry standards, best practices, and developments in assembly processes. * Modeling, teaching, and applying SEL Values, Principles of Operations, and World Class Manufacturing Principles. **This job might be for you if:** * You have a B.S. in Engineering or equivalent combination of education and experience. * You have two years' experience in process development in a related world class manufacturing company. * You can lead a cross functional team. * You can influence others and reach consensus. * You have project management experience. * You have knowledge of statistics as applied to process capability measurements. * You have effective writing, documentation, and speaking skills. * You can work cooperatively in a team environment. * You have background check results satisfactory to SEL. * You have negative drug test result(s). **It is a plus if you have:** * Thorough understanding of the materials used in the industry. **Physical Requirements** None **About Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories** SEL designs, manufactures, and supports products and systems that protect, monitor, control, and automate electric power systems. Our technologies help detect faults, prevent equipment damage, and reduce the impact of power outages. Our mission is to make electric power safer, more reliable, and more economical. Employees contribute to practical, high\-quality solutions used every day, where attention to detail and quality directly support the reliability of the electric grid. **Location:** * **Pullman, WA** – This position is located in Pullman, WA. Nestled in Eastern Washington, offering an exceptional quality of life. Embrace the charm of small\-town living with spacious surroundings, no traffic hassles, and easy access to outdoor adventures in nearby mountains, rivers, and forests. Plus, benefit from excellent schools and universities in the area. * **Lewiston, ID** – This position is located in Lewiston, ID where you'll enjoy an unmatched quality of life. Enjoy the smaller town life: country space, freedom from traffic, easy access to recreational activities in nearby mountains, rivers, and forests, as well as great schools and universities. * **West Lafayette, IN** – This position is located in West Lafayette, IN, a welcoming community that combines small\-town charm with the energy of world\-class university town. Home to Purdue University, the area is known for its innovation, strong schools, and vibrant community. Residents enjoy parks and outdoor recreation, local events, diverse dining options, and an affordable cost of living, all while being conveniently located within driving distance of Indianapolis and Chicago. **Competitive pay. Superior benefits. Inspiring work.** People are at the core of our company and we hire employee\-owners. We welcome you to learn more about how we support employees. * We’re 100% employee owned. Retirement benefits include an employer funded stock ownership plan (ESOP) and personal 401(k) options. * We offer top tier medical, prescription, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. * We recognize the importance of a healthy life balance and offer: 10 paid holidays, annual vacation accrual starting at 12 days, 9 paid sick days, and paid family and medical leave that covers 90% of your pay. * We foster growth and development of our employees through avenues such as STEM courses, apprenticeships, tuition assistance, and engineering development programs. * Ask our team about other benefits including wellness, fertility, adoption, and flexible spending benefits. **Pay Range:****$89,400 \- $134,100** **annually** We set starting pay based on job\-related factors such as your experience, training, knowledge, and skills. We are looking to fill this position at the Process Engineer level, and we welcome applicants with a range of experience. Depending on your background, we may consider you for a different level, with compensation aligned accordingly. **Communication with Applicants** We communicate with all applicants. If you do not receive a response about your application, please check your SPAM filter or reach out to us at careers@selinc.com. SEL is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Vets/Disabled.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - NY
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Scope Labs provides a full\-service startup ecosystem focused on design and development of digital platforms and experiences. We are a team of founders consisting of experienced product managers, designers, and developers. Our expertise lies in challenging fundamental assumptions, dissecting legacy behaviors, simplifying intricate processes, and delivering experiences that leave a lasting impact. We are a small, but driven team and are looking to expand! **Our Team** We're currently a small team passionate about developing the next generation of digital products. Our founding team has spent time building, designing, and scaling products at places like Google, Tesla, Palantir, Peloton, Scale AI, MIT, Yale, Columbia, Y Combinator, and more. We're currently hiring for an in person role working from warm and sunny New York City. **What We're Looking For** As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Scope Labs, you won't just be implementing solutions. You'll be embedded directly with our startup customers, owning the entire technical relationship from day one. We're looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of engineering, product instinct, and customer partnership; someone who can walk into a startup's codebase on Monday and ship something meaningful by Friday. This role is for a builder who is equally comfortable digging into a customer's production environment and white boarding a new AI workflow with their engineering lead. You'll be deploying cutting\-edge AI tooling into real startup workflows at the frontier of what's possible, and you'll be the reason those deployments succeed. The specifics of what we're building are still under wraps, but if you're excited by the idea of being one of the first people to bring genuinely new technology into the hands of fast\-moving teams, this is that role. You will represent Scope Labs in the field. That means operating with autonomy, exercising strong judgment under ambiguity, and holding yourself accountable for outcomes, not just outputs. **Responsibilities** You'll own the full technical customer lifecycle. From initial deployment through activation and ongoing utilization, you are the person who makes sure our customers are actually getting value, not just access. You'll identify and champion high\-impact use cases. You'll work closely with startup engineering teams to understand their workflows, identify where AI can meaningfully accelerate them, and get those integrations shipped. You'll be the voice of the customer internally. You'll bring patterns, friction points, and product insights back to our Product and Engineering teams, helping shape the roadmap based on what you're seeing in the field. **Preferred Qualifications** * 3\+ years in a technical, customer\-facing role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Software Engineer with consulting or startup experience. Former technical founders are strongly encouraged to apply. * Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript with a track record of shipping production software. * Hands\-on experience deploying or integrating AI tooling, including LLMs, AI agents, or AI\-native developer tools, into real workflows. * High agency with comfort operating in ambiguous environments and limited direction. * Strong communication skills across audiences, from senior engineers to non\-technical founders. * Team\-first attitude with the ability to juggle multiple customer engagements simultaneously. **Bonus Points** * Experience with AI agent frameworks, MCP servers, or autonomous coding tools in production. * Background in a specific startup or enterprise vertical such as fintech, developer tools, or healthcare. * Direct UX/UI experience or strong product sense. * A portfolio of passion projects or initiatives you've directly built or majority\-contributed to. *If you possess some of these skills but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply!* **Salary and Benefits** The expected salary range for this role is based on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Salary Range: $135,000\-$175,000 or monthly contract equivalent. This position is based in New York, NY, and requires candidates to reside in or be willing to relocate to the area. **Equal Opportunity Employer** At Scope we take pride in our best asset, our people! We focus on ensuring that our culture makes life better for the team! Scope Labs is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to diversity in its workforce. We actively encourage applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters innovation and creativity, and we welcome candidates who share our values of respect, collaboration, and excellence. jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer, AI Agents & Automation
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Site Reliability \& Infrastructure Engineering team. We run entirely on the cloud, and this team owns the reliability and health of the applications running on top of it — designing the signals that tell us when something's wrong, and building the systems that keep ServiceTitan running better, faster, and cheaper as we scale. We make a huge impact on thousands of companies in the U.S. and abroad by enabling them to be more efficient and effective at running their business. Our Site Reliability and Infrastructure Engineering team centralizes the concerns of measurement and guidance so every engineer can improve availability and efficiency in their own area of the ServiceTitan cloud. We have a cultural foundation built on diversity, inclusion, and innovation, and we want you and your ideas to thrive at ServiceTitan. Come join us. **What You'll Do** * Participate in an on\-call rotation, using runbooks and playbooks to diagnose and resolve production issues (e.g., adjusting Horizontal Pod Autoscaler rules in response to load). * Design, build, and maintain observability dashboards and alerting grounded in Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). * Operate and improve our Kubernetes\-based compute platform, which runs the large majority of our infrastructure. * Work across cloud networking and infrastructure (Azure/AWS) to support reliable, scalable systems. * Investigate and resolve production incidents, including root\-cause analysis and follow\-up remediation work. * Build and operate AI agents and automation that take on manual, repetitive SRE work directly — not just tools that assist a human doing the work. * Partner with product engineering teams to review architecture and infrastructure decisions before they ship. * Write and maintain runbooks and documentation so on\-call knowledge is shared across the team, not siloed with one person. * Help define non\-functional requirements — scalability, availability, performance — for new systems as they're designed. * Collaborate across engineering teams to adopt best practices in reliability and observability. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and help teams ship changes safely and quickly. **What You'll Bring** * Kubernetes (must\-have): strong, hands\-on understanding of Kubernetes as a system. * AI\-native SRE practice (must\-have): hands\-on, personal experience using AI tools and agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Workspace, Cursor, or custom agents built on Claude/MCP servers) to diagnose, automate, and resolve infrastructure and reliability work. + ***Agentic depth:*** You've built or operated agents that autonomously monitor infrastructure and take action (e.g., an agent that watches system load and scales, remediates, or escalates without a human in the loop) — not just general AI coding assistance. We're also open to strong Python (Flask, FastAPI) or Java (Spring) backgrounds. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: AI/ML Engineer **Location:** Atlanta, Georgia **Employment Type:** Full\-time About Sobo Sobo is building an AI\-powered business operator intelligence platform designed to help small and midsized businesses identify operational challenges, uncover opportunities, and connect insights to action. Our platform combines proprietary AI systems, business diagnostics, connected data, and expert support to help business leaders make better decisions across operations, finance, growth, technology, and organizational performance. We are looking for an experienced Senior AI/ML Engineer to work directly with our Head of AI Product \& Development and help build the full Sobo platform. About the Role This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who can take AI capabilities from concept and experimentation through production deployment. You will help architect, develop, test, and scale the intelligence layer behind Sobo. Your work will include model development, data pipelines, AI agents and workflows, platform integrations, evaluation systems, production APIs, and the infrastructure required to deliver reliable AI\-powered experiences to customers. This position is well suited for an experienced builder who is comfortable operating in an early\-stage environment, solving ambiguous problems, and taking meaningful ownership of technical outcomes. What You’ll Do * Work directly with the Head of AI Product \& Development to define and execute Sobo’s technical roadmap. * Design, develop, and improve Sobo’s AI and machine\-learning capabilities. * Build production\-ready AI workflows, agents, recommendation systems, and decision\-support tools. * Develop systems that transform business and operational data into relevant, actionable insights. * Build and maintain retrieval, inference, evaluation, and model\-monitoring pipelines. * Integrate AI capabilities with Sobo’s application, databases, APIs, and third\-party business platforms. * Improve the quality, accuracy, explainability, reliability, and security of AI\-generated outputs. * Create scalable data pipelines for structured and unstructured business information. * Evaluate models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on performance, cost, reliability, and customer requirements. * Translate product and business requirements into practical technical solutions. * Write clean, maintainable, well\-documented production code. * Help establish engineering standards, testing practices, documentation, and deployment processes. * Participate in architecture decisions and help shape the long\-term technical foundation of the Sobo platform. * Assist with the growth and development of Sobo’s future engineering team. What We’re Looking For * Demonstrated professional experience building and deploying AI or machine\-learning systems in production. * Strong proficiency in Python and modern AI/ML development frameworks. * Experience with large language models, natural\-language processing, generative AI, or related technologies. * Experience developing APIs, backend services, data pipelines, and cloud\-based applications. * Understanding of retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI\-agent workflows. * Experience working with structured and unstructured data from multiple sources. * Familiarity with model deployment, monitoring, versioning, testing, and MLOps practices. * Strong understanding of software engineering principles, system architecture, databases, and secure development. * Ability to balance experimentation with the discipline required to ship reliable production software. * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills. * Ability to work collaboratively while independently owning major technical initiatives. * Comfort working in a fast\-moving startup where priorities may evolve as the product and customer base grow. Preferred Experience * Experience building AI\-powered B2B SaaS products. * Experience developing multi\-agent or workflow\-based AI systems. * Familiarity with financial, operational, CRM, ERP, payroll, or other business\-platform data. * Experience integrating platforms such as QuickBooks, Xero, Gusto, HubSpot, or similar systems. * Experience with AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure. * Experience supporting AI systems involving sensitive business or customer data. * Previous experience in an early\-stage startup or building a product from its foundational stages. * Experience mentoring engineers or helping establish an engineering function. What Success Looks Like In this role, you will help turn Sobo’s product vision into a secure, scalable, and commercially viable platform. Success means shipping dependable AI capabilities, improving the quality of Sobo’s business insights, building systems that can scale with customer adoption, and creating a strong technical foundation for future product and engineering growth. Why Join Sobo? * Help build an ambitious AI platform from an early and influential stage. * Work directly with Sobo’s Head of AI Product \& Development and company leadership. * Take meaningful ownership of architecture, product capabilities, and technical execution. * Solve real operational problems for small and midsized businesses. * Help shape the engineering culture and future technical team. * Join an Atlanta\-based company operating at the intersection of artificial intelligence, business intelligence, and expert\-led execution. Compensation and Work Arrangement This is a paid, full\-time position based in Atlanta, Georgia. Compensation will be determined based on experience, technical background, and the scope of responsibility. How to Apply Please submit your résumé or LinkedIn profile, along with a brief description of an AI/ML product or production system you have helped build. If available, include links to relevant projects, technical portfolios, GitHub repositories, or other examples of your work. Sobo is an equal\-opportunity employer. We welcome qualified applicants from all backgrounds and evaluate candidates based on their skills, experience, and ability to contribute to the team. Pay: $69,026\.02 \- $83,128\.11 per year Work Location: In person

eyes, strong conviction, and the craft to back it up * Keep the team and leadership aligned on where design is headed, not just where it currently stands ### **Partner with Engineering to Ship Quality** * Work closely with engineering to ensure that what gets designed gets built right, own the design\-to\-dev handoff with care, precision, and a clear quality standard * Maintain spec fidelity through implementation; be the design voice in the build, not just the file, review shipped work and close quality gaps directly * Build and refine token pipelines and handoff documentation that make it easy for engineers to implement components correctly the first time * Foster a strong design\-engineering relationship, the kind where both sides understand each other's constraints and the shipped product reflects the intended design ### **Support and Elevate the UX Teams** * Partner closely with UX designers embedded across each brand to ensure system adoption is real and the work clear documentation, reusable templates, and regular hands\-on collaboration ### **Move Fast Without Losing Quality** * Work in Figma and across the best available tooling to iterate at the speed the business requires * Balance fast\-turn requests from brand teams with long\-term system integrity, know when to move and when to hold the standard * Operate with ownership and autonomy, you don't wait to be told what needs improving **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- ### **Experience** * 8\+ years of design experience, with at least 3 years in a lead or senior IC role with direct design system ownership * A portfolio that demonstrates both strong design system work *and* strong visual design execution, you need to show us you can do both, not just one * Experience working across multiple brands or products simultaneously, with a track record of maintaining system coherence across varied contexts * E\-commerce, consumer products, or DTC background strongly preferred * Deep proficiency in Figma, variables, tokens, auto\-layout, component architecture, and prototyping, and fluency with the broader tooling ecosystem * Demonstrated track record of close engineering collaboration, you've done the full cycle: designed it, handed it off, reviewed the build, and driven it to the right quality ### **Skills** * Exceptional visual design craft, you have a strong point of view on what looks and feels right, and you can execute it at the highest level * Systems thinker who can architect a design system from principles to production and communicate it clearly to developers and non\-designers alike * Comfortable producing a wide range of output: component documentation, high\-fidelity UX flows, brand\-level concept work, and future\-state visions * Strong design\-to\-engineering collaboration, comfortable reviewing live implementations, giving precise feedback in build contexts, and working directly with developers to close the gap between design intent and shipped product * Craft\-driven brand thinking, the ability to use design not just to solve UX problems, but to push a brand forward: elevate how it looks, how it feels, and how it's experienced across every touchpoint * Able to give and receive direct design feedback with confidence and clarity * Self\-directed and organized, you can manage work across three active brands and multiple system tracks without losing threads ### **Mindset** * Driven by craft, you genuinely care about the quality of the output, very detailed oriented, not just the process; quality means what's shipped, not just what's in the file * Ownership\-oriented, you see a gap and close it; you see a problem and fix it; you don't wait for someone to tell you where to look * Energized by raising the bar, making the team better, making the work better, and building something that outlasts your individual contributions * Collaborative without losing your point of view, you'll give direct design feedback, push back when the work isn't there yet, and advocate strongly for what good looks like * Partnership\-minded with engineering, you understand that great design only matters when it ships right, and you take ownership of the handoff as seriously as the design itself * Comfortable working at speed without sacrificing quality, you know how to make smart trade\-offs and you move accordingly **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building a design system from near\-zero (greenfield) state * Familiarity with design token pipelines and design\-to\-dev handoff tooling *(Style Dictionary, Theo, etc.)* * Background in brand identity or brand systems work across multiple consumer brands * Experience working across retail \+ DTC simultaneously * Exposure to front\-end implementation concepts, enough to speak engineering's language fluently and catch implementation issues on sight **Why This Role** ----------------- * **You'll own something that matters.** The design system is the infrastructure that every brand experience runs on, getting it right has real, visible business impact across three growing consumer brands * **There's a significant opportunity to make your mark.** Closet World has the audience, the business momentum, and the investment to support a real step\-change in design quality, and this role is the engine that drives that forward * **Direct visibility to leadership.** What you build here goes to the Creative Director and brand leadership, not into a backlog * **You'll have the tools and the latitude.** We're investing in the right tooling and giving this person the autonomy to set direction, not just execute against someone else's spec * **Path to grow.** As design systems scale and the brand design bar rises, this role grows with it **The pay range for this role is:** 155,000 \- 180,000 USD per year(Headquarters)

jobs.title: Scrum Master
jobs.description: Collectivus Holdings is a dynamic business group encompassing brands many of the most prestigious brands in the Collecting, Trading Card Game, and Hobby industries. With a century's worth of collective experience in driving product and service innovation, high\-end quality standards, and elevated customer experience, Collectivus brands are among the most recognized and loved throughout the world by the communities they serve. **Website:** https://www.collectivusholdings.com **Locations:** Nashville – Garland – Aarhus – Lisbon – Worldwide **Job Title:** Scrum Master **Job Location:** US \- Remote The Scrum Master owns delivery cadence, team flow, capacity visibility, and blocker removal for a cross\-functional digital product team spanning engineering, data, enterprise systems, and design. This role is accountable for how the team works: whether ceremonies drive real decisions, whether capacity and commitments are visible, and whether blockers get cleared before they cost a sprint. The Scrum Master owns the process, rhythm, and health of how the team executes, working directly with functional leads to keep the team unblocked, the cadence predictable, and delivery performance improving over time. This role ensures the team can do its best work, consistently. **Key Responsibilities** * Own delivery cadence: sprint rhythm, ceremony effectiveness, and team operating norms. * Own capacity visibility, ensuring leadership and the Product Owner always have an accurate read on what the team can realistically take on. * Own blocker removal, proactively identifying and resolving impediments — technical, organizational, or interpersonal — before they slow delivery down. * Own team flow, monitoring work\-in\-progress, cycle time, and throughput to keep work moving smoothly through the pipeline. * Own the health of the delivery process, changing it when it stops working rather than defending it out of habit. * Accountable for: Throughput, delivery predictability, cycle time, and team flow health. *Ceremonies \& Cadence* * Facilitate sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives so each ceremony drives a real decision or improvement, not a status recital. * Partner with the Product Owner to bring triaged, ready work into the sprint. * Keep sprint scope protected once committed, surfacing and pushing back on mid\-sprint scope change. * Run retrospectives that produce concrete process changes, and track that those changes actually stick. *Flow \& Capacity* * Track and report team capacity, velocity, and commitment reliability on a consistent cadence. * Monitor work\-in\-progress limits, cycle time, and throughput; identify bottlenecks in the delivery pipeline and drive changes to resolve them. * Maintain clear, accurate forecasts so the Product Owner and engineering leadership can plan with confidence. * Flag capacity risks early, each with a likely impact and a path to resolution. *Delivery Health \& Process* * Track delivery health — flow, throughput, and predictability trends — and report status on a weekly cadence to the Head of Product Engineering. * Continuously improve team process and tooling; remove ceremonies or steps that no longer earn their place. * Coach the team and functional leads on Agile/Scrum principles, fostering self\-organization and continuous improvement. * Partner with the Product Owner to keep delivery process aligned with sprint commitments and release scope. * Establish and track flow metrics, including cycle time, throughput, capacity utilization, and blocker resolution time, to identify opportunities and drive improvements in delivery performance. *Communications \& Collaboration* * Serve as the team's primary point of contact for questions on process, capacity, and impediments. * Communicate team flow health, risks, and blockers clearly to the Product Owner and cross\-functional stakeholders. * Work directly with the Product Owner, UX designer, developers, business systems analysts, and engineers day\-to\-day. * Facilitate cross\-team coordination with other Scrum Masters and Product Owners to manage dependencies across teams. **Profile** * Take ownership without being asked; makes decisions under ambiguity and stands behind them. * Direct and decisive in protecting team focus; able to push back on scope creep and hold the team to its commitments. * Precise and structured in tracking capacity, flow, and delivery health data. * Runs multiple concurrent workstreams without dropping threads; steady under pressure. * Improves systems rather than maintaining them. * Builds trust and alignment across functional leads and the Product Owner; influences without relying on formal authority. * 3\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master or in an equivalent agile delivery role, with demonstrated ownership of team flow and delivery predictability. * Experience facilitating delivery for multi\-platform or cross\-functional teams. * Strong working knowledge of Agile/Scrum and Kanban methodologies. * Comfortable using flow, capacity, and delivery data to identify bottlenecks and drive process improvement. * Experience with agile tooling (e.g., Jira, Linear, Azure DevOps) for tracking capacity, velocity, and flow metrics. **Preferred Qualifications** * Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent certification. * Experience in enterprise software environments. * Familiarity with SAFe or other scaled agile frameworks. * Background coaching multiple teams simultaneously. * Experience working with digital products at scale and within data\-driven product teams. \#LI\-Remote

jobs.description: Engineering Machine Learning Permanent New York The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most\-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. You'll work at the intersection of recommendation systems, large language models, and production\-scale machine learning infrastructure to build experiences that delight users and drive meaningful impact.
